sec: Introduction (A Introduction, B Limitation of Inline Styles)

cards.en:
Idea: Think of a house. HTML is the walls and rooms. CSS is the paint, curtains and furniture layout. You can repaint a house without moving any walls.

CSS = Cascading Style Sheet. It is a stylesheet language (a language that only describes looks). It controls colours, fonts, spacing and layout.

  • HTML: structure and content (headings, paragraphs, tables).
  • CSS: appearance and presentation.

Keeping them apart is called separating presentation from content. One HTML page can be shown with many different CSS files.

Exam wording: CSS controls the appearance and presentation of HTML elements; HTML defines the structure and content. This separates presentation from content, so the same HTML can be displayed in different styles.
cards.zh:
直觉：把网页想成一间房子：HTML 是墙和房间，CSS 是油漆、窗帘、家具摆位。换油漆不用拆墙。

CSS（Cascading Style Sheet）是一种 stylesheet language，只负责外观：颜色、字体、间距、布局。

  • HTML：结构与内容。
  • CSS：外观与呈现。

这叫 separating presentation from content。同一份 HTML 可配不同 CSS。

考试写法：CSS controls the appearance and presentation of HTML elements; HTML defines the structure and content.

ex.q: A page shows a red heading. Which part is HTML and which is CSS?
ex.a:
1. The heading text and the <h1> tag = HTML (content + structure).
  2. The red colour = CSS (h1 { color: red; }).
  3. So HTML says what is there; CSS says how it looks.
ex.az: 1. 标题文字和 <h1> 是 HTML。2. 红色是 CSS。3. HTML 管“有什么”，CSS 管“长什么样”。

ex.q: A school wants its website to have a new look for its anniversary, but keep all the text. What should be changed?
ex.a:
1. The text and structure stay the same → keep HTML.
  2. Only the look changes → replace/edit the CSS file.
  3. Benefit: no need to edit every HTML page.
ex.az: 1. 内容不变→HTML 不改。2. 只改外观→改 CSS。3. 好处：不用逐页改 HTML。

ex.q: A student writes: 'CSS is used to add paragraphs and tables to a web page.' Correct this.
ex.a:
1. Wrong: paragraphs and tables are elements → created by HTML.
  2. CSS cannot create content; it only styles existing elements.
  3. Correct: 'HTML adds paragraphs and tables; CSS sets how they look.'
ex.az: 错：段落和表格是 HTML 元素。CSS 不能新增内容，只能改外观。

cards.en:
Idea: A newspaper has words (content), fonts and colours (style), columns (layout), and sections inside pages (structure).

WordMeaningHandled by
Contenttexts, images, linksHTML
Structurehow elements are nested (li inside ul; td inside tr inside table)HTML
Stylevisual look of one element (colour, font, border)CSS
Layouthow content is arranged (alignment, spacing, size)CSS

Exam wording: HTML is responsible for content and structure; CSS is responsible for style and layout.
cards.zh:
直觉：报纸：文字是内容，字体颜色是样式，分栏是布局，版面里的区块嵌套是结构。

词意思负责
Content文字、图片、链接HTML
Structure元素如何嵌套HTML
Style单个元素外观CSS
Layout内容的排列CSS

考试写法：HTML: content and structure; CSS: style and layout.

ex.q: Classify: (i) a photo of the school, (ii) the photo is centred, (iii) <li> is inside <ul>, (iv) the link text is blue.
ex.a:
1. (i) photo = content.
  2. (ii) centred = layout.
  3. (iii) nesting = structure.
  4. (iv) blue = style.
ex.az: (i) 内容 (ii) 布局 (iii) 结构 (iv) 样式

ex.q: Which element must <td> be inside?
ex.a:
1. <td> is a table cell.
  2. It goes inside a row <tr>.
  3. <tr> goes inside <table> → this nesting is structure.
ex.az: td 在 tr 里，tr 在 table 里，这是结构。

ex.q: A student says 'Putting 20px space between two paragraphs is part of the content.' Right?
ex.a:
1. Wrong. Space is not information.
  2. Spacing is layout (arrangement), set by CSS margin.
  3. Content = text, images, links only.
ex.az: 错。间距是布局，用 CSS margin 设定。

cards.en:
Idea: Like writing a sticky note directly on one item: it only affects that item.

An inline style is CSS written in an element's style attribute.

  • Value = list of property: value pairs.
  • Pairs separated by ;
  • Affects only this element.
  • It has the highest specificity (it wins conflicts).

Exam wording: An inline style is written in the style attribute of an element and applies only to that element.
cards.zh:
直觉：像在一件物品上直接贴便条，只影响这一件。

Inline style 写在元素的 style attribute 里。

  • 内容是 property: value，用 ; 分隔。
  • 只影响该元素。
  • Specificity 最高。

考试写法：An inline style is written in the style attribute of an element and applies only to that element.

ex.q: Make one paragraph blue and centred.
ex.a:
1. Find the <p> tag.
  2. Add style="color: blue; text-align: center".
  3. Result: <p style="color: blue; text-align: center">Hi</p>
ex.az: 在 <p> 加 style="color: blue; text-align: center"。

ex.q: Two paragraphs; only the second has an inline style color:red. What colour is the first?
ex.a:
1. Inline style only affects its own element.
  2. First <p> has no style → default black.
ex.az: 第一段没有 style，保持默认黑色。

ex.q: A student writes <p style="color=red, font-size=20px">. What's wrong?
ex.a:
1. Use colon : not = between property and value.
  2. Use semicolon ; not comma between pairs.
  3. Correct: style="color: red; font-size: 20px"
ex.az: 错：要用冒号和分号，不是 = 和逗号。

demo.html:
Lily thinks it's wonderful to fly.

This paragraph has no style.

code.src: Lily thinks it's wonderful to fly.

notes.t:
Opening

tag with a style attribute: blue text, centred.
notes.tz: 开始标签，style 属性：蓝色、居中。

notes.t: Closing tag; the style stops here.
notes.tz: 结束标签，样式到此为止。

cards.en:
Idea: Imagine painting 12 chairs red one by one, then being told to repaint them pink. Painful.

  1. Lack of code reusability: one inline style → one element only; the same style must be copied into every element.
  2. Reduced maintainability: to change the colour you must edit every element; easy to miss one.
  3. Entangled code: style mixed with structure → HTML is long and hard to read.

Fix: use selectors in an internal or external style sheet.

Exam wording: Lack of code reusability; reduced maintainability; entangled code (style mixed with HTML structure, hard to read).
cards.zh:
直觉：像把 12 张椅子逐张涂红，之后又要全部改粉红，很麻烦。

  1. Lack of code reusability：只作用一个元素，要到处复制。
  2. Reduced maintainability：改颜色要逐个改，容易漏。
  3. Entangled code：样式和结构混在一起，难读。

解决：用 selector 写在 style sheet。

考试写法：Lack of code reusability; reduced maintainability; entangled code.

ex.q: 12 <li> items with girls' names must be red. Using inline styles, how many style attributes?
ex.a:
1. Each <li> needs its own style.
  2. 12 elements → 12 style attributes.
  3. With a class selector: 1 rule + class on each item.
ex.az: 12 个；用 class selector 只需写 1 条规则。

ex.q: The colour changes from red to pink. Which limitation appears?
ex.a:
1. You must edit all 12 inline styles by hand.
  2. This is reduced maintainability.

ex.q: A student says: 'Inline styles are bad because they don't work in Chrome.' Correct?
ex.a:
1. Wrong: inline styles work in every browser.
  2. The real problems: reusability, maintainability, entangled code.
ex.az: 错：inline style 能用，问题在于重用性、维护性和代码纠缠。

demo.html:
• Amy
  • Bella
  • Cindy

Try changing all to pink: you must edit 3 places!

cards.tz: 网页用户体验设计 Web UX
cards.en:
Idea: A good shop is easy to walk around, has clear signs, and works for wheelchair users too. A good website is the same.

Web UX design creates sites that are visually appealing, easy to navigate and functional, focusing on usability, accessibility and performance.

  • Team: UI designers, developers, content creators, data analysts.
  • User-centred design: based on real users' needs.
  • Universal design: usable by people with different abilities.
  • Methods: user research, iterative testing, accessibility guidelines.

Exam wording: UX design focuses on usability, accessibility and performance, using user-centred and universal design with user research and iterative testing.
cards.zh:
直觉：好商店好走、标示清楚、轮椅也能进。好网站也一样。

Web UX design：网站要美观、易导航、能用，重视 usability、accessibility、performance。

  • User-centred design：以用户需要为本。
  • Universal design：不同能力的人都能用。
  • 方法：user research、iterative testing。

考试写法：UX design focuses on usability, accessibility and performance.

ex.q: A site adds alt text to images for blind users. Which principle?
ex.a:
1. Helps people with different abilities.
  2. → Universal design / accessibility.
ex.az: 帮助不同能力的人 → universal design。

ex.q: Designers test a prototype with 5 students, fix problems, then test again. Name the method.
ex.a:
1. Test → improve → test again.
  2. → Iterative testing.
ex.az: 测试→改进→再测 → iterative testing。

ex.q: A student says 'UX is just making the website look pretty.' Correct?
ex.a:
1. Wrong: looks are only part.
  2. UX also covers usability, accessibility and performance (speed).
ex.az: 错：UX 还包括易用、无障碍和性能。

cards.en:
Idea: Every element is a parcel: the item (content), bubble wrap (padding), the cardboard (border), and space between parcels on the shelf (margin).

The browser treats every HTML element as a box. From inside out:

content → padding → border → margin

  • The border is invisible by default.
  • Background colour fills content + padding, not margin.

Exam wording: Every HTML element is rendered as a box: content, padding, border and margin (from inside to outside).
cards.zh:
直觉：每个元素是一个包裹：物品（content）、气泡膜（padding）、纸箱（border）、包裹间的空位（margin）。

浏览器把每个 HTML 元素当作一个盒。由内到外：content → padding → border → margin。

  • border 默认看不见。
  • 背景色填 content + padding，不填 margin。

考试写法：content, padding, border, margin（由内到外）。

ex.q: Order the parts from outside to inside.
ex.a:
1. Outermost: margin.
  2. Then border.
  3. Then padding.
  4. Innermost: content.
ex.az: 由外到内：margin → border → padding → content。

ex.q: A <p> has padding:10px; border:solid; margin:20px;. How far is the text from the border?
ex.a:
1. Distance text→border = padding.
  2. = 10px.

ex.q: A student says 'margin is the space between the text and the border.' Correct it.
ex.a:
1. Wrong: that's padding.
  2. Margin is outside the border, between this box and others.
ex.az: 错：那是 padding；margin 在边框外。

cards.en:
Idea: A new phone has factory settings. You only change the ones you care about.

Each element has many style properties (color, font-size, border...). If no CSS is given, the browser uses the default value (e.g. <h1> big and bold, black text, no border).

To change the look, assign a new value to a style property. One rule can change many elements at once.

Exam wording: If no style is specified, the browser uses the default value of each style property.
cards.zh:
直觉：新手机有出厂设定，你只改想改的。

每个元素有很多 style properties。没写 CSS 就用 default value（h1 大而粗、黑字、无边框）。

改外观＝给 property 设新值。

考试写法：没有指定样式时，浏览器使用每个属性的默认值。

ex.q: Why is an unstyled <h1> big and bold?
ex.a:
1. No CSS was written.
  2. Browser uses <h1>'s default font-size and font-weight.

ex.q: Make all <p> text Arial. Which property changes?
ex.a:
1. Font typeface → font-family.
  2. p { font-family: Arial; }

ex.q: A student thinks a box has no border property because none is visible. Correct?
ex.a:
1. Wrong: the border property exists.
  2. Its default style is none, so it's invisible.
  3. Set border: solid; to see it.
ex.az: 错：有 border 属性，只是默认看不见。

cards.t: CSS syntax: selector and declaration block
cards.tz: CSS 语法：选择器与声明块
cards.en:
Idea: A CSS rule is like an order: WHO (selector) + WHAT to do (declarations).

  • Selector: which elements.
  • Declaration block: inside { }.
  • Declaration: property: value; — colon between, semicolon after.

Exam wording: A CSS rule consists of a selector and a declaration block; each declaration assigns a value to a style property.
cards.zh:
直觉：CSS 规则像一张指令：对谁（selector）+ 做什么（declarations）。

  • Selector：选哪些元素。
  • Declaration block：在 { } 里。
  • Declaration：property: value;

考试写法：A CSS rule consists of a selector and a declaration block.

ex.q: Label the parts of h1 { color: red; }.
ex.a:
1. h1 = selector.
  2. { color: red; } = declaration block.
  3. color = property, red = value.
ex.az: h1 是 selector；{…} 是 declaration block；color 是 property，red 是 value。

ex.q: Write a rule: all <h2> underlined and coral background.
ex.a:
1. Selector: h2.
  2. Two declarations, each ending with ;
  3. h2 { text-decoration: underline; background-color: coral; }

ex.q: What's wrong: p ( color = blue )?
ex.a:
1. Use curly brackets { }, not ( ).
  2. Use colon : not =.
  3. Correct: p { color: blue; }

notes.t: Selector h1: apply to every <h1>; block opens.
notes.tz: 选择器 h1，作用于所有 <h1>，开始声明块。

cards.t: Where to put CSS: internal vs external (overview)
cards.en:
Idea: You can write notes in the same notebook (internal) or keep a separate rule book shared by everyone (external).

  • Inline: style attribute of one element.
  • Internal style sheet: inside <style>…</style>, usually in <head>.
  • External style sheet: separate .css file, linked by <link>.

Exam wording: Internal: CSS in a <style> element in the HTML file. External: CSS in a separate .css file linked with <link rel="stylesheet" href="...">.
cards.zh:
直觉：笔记写在同一本（internal），或另外一本大家共用的规则书（external）。

  • Inline：元素的 style 属性。
  • Internal：<style> 内，放 <head>。
  • External：独立 .css 文件，用 <link> 连接。

考试写法：Internal 用 <style>；External 用 .css 文件和 <link>。

ex.q: Name the method: <link rel="stylesheet" href="a.css">
ex.a:
1. Uses <link> to a .css file.
  2. → External style sheet.

ex.q: Name the method: CSS inside <style> in <head>.
ex.a:
1. CSS in the same HTML file.
  2. → Internal style sheet.

ex.q: A student puts <style> tags inside style.css. Problem?
ex.a:
1. Wrong: a .css file contains only CSS.
  2. Remove <style> tags; they belong in HTML only.
ex.az: 错：.css 文件只放 CSS，不要 <style>。

code.src:
<head>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="style.css">
  <style>
    p { color: green; }
  </style>
</head>

cards.en:
Idea: Calling people: 'All students!' (element), 'Students in the choir!' (class), 'Tom Ho!' (ID).

KindLooks likeMatches
Element-wise (type)pall elements of that type
Class.girlall elements with that class
ID#namethe one element with that id

Exam wording: Element-wise selector: element name, no symbol; class selector: starts with '.'; ID selector: starts with '#'.
cards.zh:
直觉：叫人：“全体学生！”（element）、“合唱团的同学！”（class）、“何同学！”（ID）。

种类写法选中
Elementp所有该类元素
Class.girl有该 class 的元素
ID#name唯一一个元素

考试写法：无符号＝element；. ＝class；# ＝ID。

ex.q: Identify: #top, li, .note.
ex.a:
1. # → ID.
  2. no symbol → element.
  3. . → class.
ex.az: #top 是 ID，li 是 element，.note 是 class。

ex.q: Style every <li> with class 'senior' underlined.
ex.a:
1. Group → class selector.
  2. .senior { text-decoration: underline; }

ex.q: A student writes #girl to style 6 girls with class="girl". Problem?
ex.a:
1. Wrong symbol: # selects id.
  2. class needs a dot: .girl.

cards.en:
Idea: A rule for everyone of one kind: 'all paragraphs look like this'.

Write an HTML element name with no symbol: p, li, table. It styles all elements of that type. It has the lowest specificity.

Exam wording: An element-wise selector applies the declarations to all elements of that type in the document.
cards.zh:
直觉：对同一种元素一视同仁：“所有段落都这样”。

直接写元素名，无符号：p、li、table。作用于所有该类元素，specificity 最低。

考试写法：Element-wise selector 作用于文档中所有该类元素。

ex.q: h1 { text-decoration: underline; }; page has one <h1> and four <li>. What is underlined?
ex.a:
1. h1 matches only <h1>.
  2. Only the heading text is underlined. [Textbook Ch1 Checkpoint 1.1(a)]

ex.q: Make all table rows have a light grey background.
ex.a:
1. Rows are <tr>.
  2. tr { background-color: lightgrey; }

ex.q: A student writes <p> { color: red; } in CSS. Error?
ex.a:
1. Wrong: no angle brackets in a selector.
  2. Correct: p { color: red; }

cards.t: The id attribute and ID selector
cards.tz: id 属性与 ID 选择器
cards.en:
Idea: An id is like a student number: no two students share it.

  • HTML: id="name" (no #).
  • Each id must be unique within one page.
  • CSS: #name { ... } styles only that element.

Exam wording: The id attribute is a unique identifier of an element in a web page; an ID selector (#id) applies only to the element with that id.
cards.zh:
直觉：id 像学号，不会两人相同。

  • HTML 写 id="name"（无 #）。
  • 每页中 id 必须唯一。
  • CSS 写 #name { }，只作用于该元素。

考试写法：id 是页内唯一标识；#id 只作用于该元素。

ex.q: Style <h1 id="name"> with coral background and white text.
ex.a:
1. ID selector: #name.
  2. #name { background-color: coral; color: white; }

ex.q: Can two <p> on one page both have id="intro"?
ex.a:
1. No: ids must be unique per page.
  2. Use a class for groups.
ex.az: 不行，id 必须唯一；多个用 class。

ex.q: A student writes <h1 id="#name">. Why does #name not match?
ex.a:
1. Wrong: # is only in CSS.
  2. The id becomes '#name' literally.
  3. Correct: id="name".
ex.az: 错：HTML 的 id 不加 #。

code.src: Lily's Bio

notes.t: ID rule: only the element with id="name".
notes.tz: ID 规则：只作用于 id="name"。

notes.t: This h1 has id name → styled.
notes.tz: 此 h1 的 id 是 name → 被套用。

cards.t: Class selector and the class attribute
cards.tz: 类选择器与 class 属性
cards.en:
Idea: A class is like a club badge: many people can wear it, and one person can wear several badges.

  • CSS: .girl { color: pink; }
  • HTML: class="girl"; several classes separated by spaces: class="girl senior".
  • Class names cannot contain spaces; join words with a hyphen (sci-teacher).

Exam wording: A class selector (.name) applies to all elements whose class attribute contains that class name; an element can have multiple classes separated by spaces.
cards.zh:
直觉：class 像社团徽章：很多人可戴，一人可戴几个。

  • CSS：.girl { }
  • HTML：class="girl senior"，多个 class 用空格分隔。
  • class 名不能有空格，用连字号。

考试写法：Class selector 作用于所有含该 class 的元素；一个元素可有多个 class。

ex.q: Sandy has class="girl senior"; CSS: .girl{color:pink} .senior{text-decoration:underline}. Her style?
ex.a:
1. Matches .girl → pink.
  2. Matches .senior → underlined.
  3. No conflict → pink and underlined.

ex.q: Give 3 science teachers the same style.
ex.a:
1. Add class="sci-teacher" to each.
  2. CSS .sci-teacher { ... }.

ex.q: A student writes class="science teacher" intending one class. What happens?
ex.a:
1. Space splits it into two classes: science and teacher.
  2. .science-teacher would not match.
  3. Use science-teacher.
ex.az: 错：空格变两个 class，用连字号。

demo.html:
• James (F5, Boy)
  • Amy (F2, Girl)
  • Sandy (F5, Girl)

code.src:
.girl   { color: pink; }
.senior { text-decoration: underline; }

notes.t: Every element with class girl → pink.
notes.tz: 所有 class 含 girl 的元素变粉红。

notes.t: Every element with class senior → underlined.
notes.tz: 所有 class 含 senior 的元素加下划线。

cards.en:
Idea: ID = one name tag for one person. Class = a uniform many people wear.

IDClass
Symbol#.
Matchesone unique elementany number
Per elementone idmany classes
Specificityhigherlower

Exam wording: Use an ID selector for one unique element; use a class selector for a group of elements sharing the same style.
cards.zh:
直觉：ID＝一人一个名牌；class＝多人穿的制服。

IDClass
符号#.
选中唯一一个任意多个
每元素一个 id多个 class
Specificity较高较低

考试写法：单一元素用 ID；一组元素用 class。

ex.q: The page logo appears once. ID or class?
ex.a:
1. Only one element.
  2. → ID.

ex.q: All 'locker' locations in a table must be green. ID or class?
ex.a:
1. Many elements.
  2. → class, e.g. .locker.

ex.q: A student gives 5 buttons id="btn" and uses #btn. Problem?
ex.a:
1. Wrong: ids must be unique.
  2. Use class="btn" and .btn.
ex.az: 错：id 不能重复，应用 class。

cards.t: Which elements a property applies to
cards.en:
Idea: A 'sleeve length' setting only makes sense for shirts, not for hats.

  • Some properties work on almost all elements: margin, padding.
  • Some only on particular elements: list-style only on <ul>/<ol>.
  • Wrong element → browser ignores it, no error.

Groups: font-related (color, font-family, font-weight, font-size, text-decoration) and layout-related (text-align, border, padding, margin, height, width, background-color).

Exam wording: Some style properties apply to almost all elements (e.g. margin, padding) while some only apply to particular elements (e.g. list-style for ul/ol).
cards.zh:
直觉：“袖长”只适用于衣服，不适用于帽子。

  • margin、padding 几乎适用所有元素。
  • list-style 只适用 ul/ol。
  • 用错元素：浏览器忽略，不报错。

考试写法：有些属性适用几乎所有元素，有些只适用特定元素。

ex.q: Does padding work on <h1>?
ex.a:
1. Every element is a box.
  2. Yes, padding applies to almost all elements.

ex.q: Change bullets of a list to squares.
ex.a:
1. Property list-style applies to <ul>.
  2. ul { list-style: square; }

ex.q: A student writes p { list-style: square; } and expects an error message. What really happens?
ex.a:
1. No error.
  2. list-style doesn't apply to <p> → silently ignored.

cards.en:
Idea: You can name a colour, mix it from red/green/blue numbers, or write those numbers in hex.

color sets text colour. Three value formats:

FormatExample
Namered, coral
Hex RGB#ff8833 (RR GG BB, 00–FF)
rgb()rgb(144,3,20) (0–255 each)

#FFFFFF = white, #000000 = black.

Exam wording: Colour values can be a colour name, a hexadecimal RGB value (#RRGGBB) or rgb(r, g, b) with each part from 0 to 255.
cards.zh:
直觉：颜色可以直接叫名字，或用红绿蓝数字调出来，或把数字写成十六进制。

color 设文字颜色。三种写法：名字、#RRGGBB、rgb(r,g,b)（0–255）。

考试写法：Colour name、hex #RRGGBB、rgb(r,g,b)。

ex.q: Convert #FF8000 to rgb().
Write pure green in all three formats.
ex.a:
1. Name: lime (note: 'green' is #008000).
  2. Hex: #00FF00.
  3. rgb: rgb(0,255,0).

ex.q: A student writes rgb(300,0,0). Problem?
ex.a:
1. Each part is 0–255.
  2. 300 is out of range (browser clamps to 255).
  3. Write rgb(255,0,0).

cards.en:
Idea: Choosing a font is like choosing handwriting style, how thick the pen is, and how big you write.

  • font-family: typeface. font-family: Arial; Names with spaces need quotes. List fallbacks: Georgia, serif; browser uses the first available.
  • font-weight: boldness, bold.
  • font-size: size, usually px: 12px.

Exam wording: font-family sets the typeface (first available font in the list is used); font-weight sets boldness; font-size sets text size, e.g. in px.
cards.zh:
直觉：选字体像选笔迹、笔粗细和字大小。

  • font-family：字体，有空格要加引号，可列后备字体。
  • font-weight：粗细。
  • font-size：大小，常用 px。

考试写法：font-family 字体；font-weight 粗细；font-size 大小。

ex.q: Make all paragraphs Courier New, 14px, bold.
ex.a:
1. Quotes for a name with a space.
  2. p { font-family: "Courier New"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: bold; }
ex.az: p { font-family: "Courier New"; font-size: 14px; font-weight: bold; }

ex.q: font-family: Fancy, Arial, sans-serif; and Fancy is not installed. Which font?
ex.a:
1. Try Fancy → not available.
  2. Next: Arial → available → Arial is used.

ex.q: A student writes font-size: 14;. What's wrong?
ex.a:
1. Missing unit.
  2. Browser ignores it. Write 14px.

cards.en:
Idea: Decoration = lines drawn on the words. Align = where the words sit on the line.

  • text-decoration: underline, line-through, overline, none (remove link underline).
  • text-align: left, right, center, justify.

Book misprint: font-decoration does not exist; it's text-decoration.

Exam wording: text-decoration adds lines (e.g. underline) to text; text-align sets the horizontal alignment of text in an element.
cards.zh:
直觉：decoration 是在文字上画线；align 是文字在行内的位置。

  • text-decoration：underline、line-through、none…
  • text-align：left、right、center、justify。

课本 font-decoration 是印错，应为 text-decoration。

考试写法：text-decoration 加线；text-align 水平对齐。

ex.q: Remove underlines from all links.
ex.a:
1. Links are <a>.
  2. a { text-decoration: none; }

ex.q: Centre the <h1>.
ex.a: 1. h1 { text-align: center; }

ex.q: A student writes p { font-decoration: underline; }. Result?
ex.a:
1. No such property → ignored, not underlined.
  2. Use text-decoration.

demo.html:
Centred title

Normal old price

Link with no underline

cards.en:
Idea: Like the colour of the paper behind the words.

background-color fills the content + padding (not margin). Same 3 colour formats. On <body> it colours the whole page. Make sure text and background contrast.

Exam wording: background-color sets the colour behind an element's content and padding.
cards.zh:
直觉：像文字后面纸张的颜色。

填满 content + padding（不含 margin）。在 body 上就是整页。注意文字与背景要有对比。

考试写法：background-color 设元素内容和 padding 的背景色。

ex.q: Make the whole page aliceblue.
ex.a: 1. body { background-color: aliceblue; }

ex.q: A box has padding 20px and margin 20px with yellow background. Is the margin yellow?
ex.a:
1. Background covers content + padding only.
  2. Margin shows the parent's colour → not yellow.

ex.q: A student uses white text on a light yellow background. Problem?
ex.a:
1. Poor contrast → hard to read.
  2. Use dark text or a dark background.

cards.en:
Idea: The border is the box's outline, like the frame of a picture.

  • border: solid; / dashed / dotted
  • Shorthand: border: solid red 2px; = style, colour, width.
  • Default: invisible (none). Sits between padding and margin.

Exam wording: The border property sets the style, colour and width of the border around an element's padding.
cards.zh:
直觉：border 是盒的外框，像画框。

  • border: solid / dashed / dotted
  • 简写：border: solid red 2px（样式、颜色、宽度）。
  • 默认看不见；位于 padding 和 margin 之间。

考试写法：border 设元素边框的样式、颜色和宽度。

ex.q: Give 'cheap' items a light blue 2px solid border.
ex.a: 1. .cheap { border: solid lightblue 2px; }

ex.q: Change a dashed border to solid without changing colour/width.
ex.a:
1. Edit only the style word.
  2. border: dashed red 2px; → border: solid red 2px;
ex.az: 只把 dashed 改成 solid。

ex.q: A student writes border: red 2px; and sees nothing. Why?
ex.a:
1. No style given → default style none → invisible.
  2. Add solid.
ex.az: 错：缺样式 solid，默认 none 看不见。

demo.html:
solid red 2px

dashed

no style word

cards.en:
Idea: Padding is cushioning inside the box. Margin is personal space outside it.

  • padding: space between content and border. Sides: padding-top/right/bottom/left.
  • margin: space between elements or between an element and the page edge. margin-top etc.
  • height / width: size of the box, e.g. height: 50px; width: 150px;

Exam wording: Padding is the space between the content and the border; margin is the space between an element and other elements (or the page edge).
cards.zh:
直觉：padding 是盒内的垫子；margin 是盒外的私人空间。

  • padding：内容与边框间。
  • margin：元素之间或元素与页边。
  • height/width：盒的高宽。

考试写法：padding：内容与边框之间；margin：元素与其他元素之间。

ex.q: Put 20px space above the text inside a bordered box.
ex.a:
1. Inside the border → padding.
  2. padding-top: 20px;

ex.q: Move a <div> 40px away from the left edge of the page.
ex.a:
1. Outside the box → margin.
  2. margin-left: 40px;

ex.q: A student uses margin to push text away from its own border. Result?
ex.a:
1. Wrong property: margin moves the whole box, the text still touches the border.
  2. Use padding.

cards.en:
Idea: CSS only speaks American English. A wrong spelling is silently ignored.

  • Use color, background-color, text-align: center.
  • colour, centre, font-decoration → ignored, no error.

Exam wording: In CSS code always write color and center (American spelling).
cards.zh:
直觉：CSS 只认美式拼法，拼错会被悄悄忽略。

  • 要写 color、center。
  • colour、centre 会被忽略，不报错。

考试写法：代码中一律写 color 和 center。

ex.q: Fix h1 { colour: green; text-align: centre; }.
ex.a:
1. colour → color.
  2. centre → center.
  3. h1 { color: green; text-align: center; }

ex.q: Which declaration still works in p { colour: red; font-size: 20px; }?
ex.a:
1. colour ignored.
  2. font-size works → 20px, black text.

ex.q: A student says the browser will show an error for 'colour'. True?
ex.a:
1. False: CSS skips unknown declarations silently.
  2. That's why the bug is hard to spot.

cards.en:
Idea: When two teachers give different instructions, you follow the one with more authority.

When two or more declarations set the same property of the same element, specificity decides which wins.

  1. Inline style beats all.
  2. ID > class > element.
  3. Equal: later rule wins.
  4. Only the conflicting property is overridden; other properties still apply.

Exam wording: Specificity is the rule used by the browser to decide which selector is the most relevant to an element, so its declaration is applied when declarations conflict.
cards.zh:
直觉：两位老师指示不同，你听权威较高的。

多个声明设定同一元素的同一属性时，由 specificity 决定。

  1. Inline 最高。
  2. ID > class > element。
  3. 同级：后定义者胜。
  4. 只覆盖冲突的属性。

考试写法：Specificity 决定哪个 selector 对元素最相关。

ex.q: p{color:blue} #intro{color:red}; <p id="intro">. Colour?
ex.a:
1. Both set color → conflict.
  2. ID beats element → red.

ex.q: p{color:blue;font-size:20px} #intro{color:red}. Font size of #intro?
ex.a:
1. Only color conflicts.
  2. font-size not in conflict → 20px still applies.

ex.q: A student thinks the winning rule replaces ALL properties of the losing rule. Correct?
ex.a:
1. Wrong: only the conflicting property is overridden.
  2. Non-conflicting properties from both rules apply.

demo.css:
p { color: blue; font-size: 20px; }
#intro { color: red; }

cards.en:
Idea: A sticky note on the item itself beats the general rule book.

If a property is set in an inline style and also in CSS, the inline value is used. Other properties from CSS still apply.

Exam wording: Inline style has the highest specificity, so it overrides internal and external style sheets.
cards.zh:
直觉：贴在物品上的便条比规则手册优先。

同一属性在 inline 和 CSS 都有时，用 inline 的值；其他属性照用 CSS。

考试写法：Inline style specificity 最高。

ex.q: #intro{color:red;border:solid}; <p style="color:LightSeaGreen" id="intro">. Result?
ex.a:
1. color: inline wins → LightSeaGreen.
  2. border: only in CSS → solid border applies.

ex.q: Make only one of ten <p> green by changing one line.
ex.a:
1. Add inline style to that element.
  2. <p style="color: green">
ex.az: 在该 p 加 style="color: green"。

ex.q: A student thinks an ID rule written after the element beats its inline style. Correct?
ex.a:
1. Wrong: position doesn't matter here.
  2. Inline always beats ID/class/element.

demo.html: Inline wins for color

cards.en:
Idea: The more precisely you point at one element, the stronger the rule.

Inline > ID > class > element. Between different levels, order in the CSS does not matter.

Method: for each property list matching rules → pick highest level → if tie, the later one.

Exam wording: Inline styles > ID selectors > class selectors > element-wise selectors.
cards.zh:
直觉：指得越准，规则越强。

Inline > ID > class > element。不同级别时，CSS 中的先后无关。

考试写法：Inline > ID > class > element。

ex.q: #intro{color:red} then .highlight{color:blue}; <h1 id="intro" class="highlight">.
ex.a:
1. ID vs class → ID wins.
  2. red.

ex.q: .x{color:green} li{color:orange;font-weight:bold}; <li class="x">.
ex.a:
1. color: class beats element → green.
  2. font-weight: only li → bold.
  3. → green and bold.

ex.q: A student says .highlight{color:blue} written after #intro{color:red} wins because it's later. Correct?
ex.a:
1. Wrong: 'later wins' only for equal specificity.
  2. ID beats class → red.

demo.html:
ID vs class

  • class + element

cards.t: Equal specificity: the later rule wins
cards.en:
Idea: Two equal-rank instructions: the most recent one counts.

Same specificity (e.g. two classes) setting the same property → the rule defined later in the CSS wins.

Exam wording: If selectors have the same specificity, the declaration defined later is applied.
cards.zh:
直觉：同级指示，以最新那条为准。

同级（如两个 class）冲突 → CSS 中较后定义的胜。

考试写法：同级时，后定义的声明生效。

ex.q: .intro{color:green} .highlight{color:red}; <p class="intro highlight">.
ex.a:
1. Two classes, equal.
  2. .highlight is later → red.

ex.q: p{color:blue} then p{color:purple}. <p> colour?
ex.a:
1. Equal element selectors.
  2. Later → purple.

ex.q: A student swaps the class attribute to class="highlight intro" to get green. Works?
ex.a:
1. No: attribute order doesn't matter.
  2. Must move .intro rule after .highlight in CSS.
ex.az: 不行：要改 CSS 中规则的顺序。

demo.html:
intro highlight

highlight intro

cards.en:
Idea: The order you list your clubs on a form doesn't change club rules.

class="a b" = class="b a". Only the order of rules in the CSS matters for equal specificity.

Exam wording: The order of class names in the class attribute has no effect; only the order of declarations in the style sheet matters.
cards.zh:
直觉：表格上列社团的次序不影响社团规则。

class="a b" 与 class="b a" 一样。只有 CSS 中规则次序有影响。

考试写法：class 属性内的次序无影响。

ex.q: CSS .intro{color:green} .highlight{color:red}. Colours of class="intro highlight" and class="highlight intro"?
ex.a:
1. Both: .highlight later.
  2. Both red.

ex.q: How to make them green without inline style?
ex.a:
1. Move .intro rule after .highlight, or
  2. use an ID selector.
ex.az: 把 .intro 移到后面或用 ID。

ex.q: A student says the last class name in the attribute wins. Fix.
ex.a:
1. Wrong.
  2. Order in the CSS file decides, not the attribute.

demo.css:
.highlight { color: red; }
.intro { color: green; }  /* now later → both green */

cards.t: Changing the element tag and specificity
cards.en:
Idea: If you change a student's class from 4A to 4B, the 4A rules stop applying to them.

Changing the tag changes which element selectors match. ID and class rules still match.

Exam wording: After changing the tag, the element-wise selector no longer matches, so the element uses the new tag's default style; ID/class rules still apply.
cards.zh:
直觉：学生由 4A 转到 4B，4A 的规则就不再适用。

换标签 → 元素选择器不再匹配；ID/class 仍然匹配。

考试写法：换标签后元素选择器不再匹配，改用新标签的默认样式。

ex.q: #title{color:red} p{color:blue;font-size:10px}; <p id="title">. Style?
ex.a:
1. color: ID wins → red.
  2. font-size: only p → 10px.

ex.q: Same CSS, tag changed to <h1 id="title">. Style?
ex.a:
1. p no longer matches → lose 10px.
  2. h1 default: large, bold.
  3. #title still → red.

ex.q: A student writes <p id="title">...</h1> (as printed in the book). Problem?
ex.a:
1. Mismatched tags.
  2. Closing tag must match: </p>.

demo.html:
As a p

As an h1
demo.css:
#title, #title2 { color: red; }
p { color: blue; font-size: 10px; }

cards.en:
Idea: Rules written inside the same notebook they apply to.

CSS between <style> and </style>, best placed in <head> (readability, not entangled with body).

  • Advantages: one file, convenient for small projects; faster loading (no extra request).
  • Disadvantages: limited reusability (one page only); hard to keep many pages consistent.

Exam wording: An internal style sheet is placed in a <style> element in the <head> of the HTML file; it loads faster but cannot be reused by other pages.
cards.zh:
直觉：规则写在它所适用的同一本笔记里。

CSS 写在 <style> 中，最好放 <head>。

  • 优点：一个文件、方便；载入较快。
  • 缺点：重用性有限。

考试写法：Internal style sheet 放在 head 的 <style>；载入快但不能被其他页面重用。

ex.q: Write an internal style sheet making .girl pink.
ex.a:
1. In <head> add <style>.
  2. Write .girl { color: pink; }.
  3. Close </style>.
ex.az: 在 head 加 <style>.girl { color: pink; }</style>。

ex.q: Give one advantage of internal over external.
ex.a:
1. No separate file to request.
  2. → faster loading.

ex.q: A student puts <style> inside a <p> element. Allowed? Good?
ex.a:
1. Browsers accept it, but it's bad practice.
  2. Put it in <head> for readability and to avoid entangled code.

code.src:
<head>
  <style>
    .girl { color: pink; }
  </style>
</head>

cards.t: External style sheet and the <link> element
cards.en:
Idea: One rule book shared by every classroom: change it once, every room follows.

A separate .css file with only CSS. Link it in <head>:

<link rel="stylesheet" href="style.css">

  • rel="stylesheet": the file is a CSS style sheet.
  • href: path to the file.
  • Advantages: reused by many pages, consistent style, easy maintenance, team can work in parallel.
  • Disadvantage: extra request, slightly slower first load.

Exam wording: An external style sheet is a separate .css file linked with <link rel="stylesheet" href="...">; it can be shared by many pages for a consistent style and easy maintenance.
cards.zh:
直觉：一本所有课室共用的规则书，改一次全部跟着变。

独立 .css 文件只放 CSS，用 <link rel="stylesheet" href="style.css"> 连接。

  • 优点：多页共用、风格一致、易维护。
  • 缺点：多一次请求。

考试写法：外部样式表：多页共用，风格一致，易维护。

ex.q: Link style.css in folder css.
ex.a:
1. Relative path css/style.css.
  2. <link rel="stylesheet" href="css/style.css">

ex.q: A school site has 50 pages. Why external?
ex.a:
1. All 50 pages link one file.
  2. Consistent style; change colour once → all pages update.

ex.q: A student writes <link href="style.css"> without rel. Problem?
ex.a:
1. Missing rel="stylesheet": browser doesn't treat it as CSS.
  2. Add rel="stylesheet".

notes.t: Comment: file name. A .css file has no <style> tags.

code.src:
<head>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="style.css">
</head>

cards.en:
Idea: Relative = 'the room next door'. Absolute = full street address.

  • Relative path: relative to the HTML file's location, same server/domain: style.css, css/style.css, ../style.css.
  • Absolute path: full location like a URL, often for third-party CSS on another domain: https://cdn.example.com/a.css.

Exam wording: A relative path locates the file relative to the current HTML file on the same server; an absolute path gives the full URL, used for files on other domains.
cards.zh:
直觉：相对路径像“隔壁房间”；绝对路径像完整地址。

  • 相对路径：相对于 HTML 文件位置，同一服务器。
  • 绝对路径：完整 URL，常用于其他网域的第三方 CSS。

考试写法：相对路径：相对目前 HTML 文件；绝对路径：完整 URL。

ex.q: index.html is in /site; CSS is /site/css/main.css. Relative href?
ex.a:
1. From /site go into css.
  2. href="css/main.css"

ex.q: page.html is in /site/pages; CSS in /site/style.css.
ex.a:
1. Go up one folder: ../
  2. href="../style.css"

ex.q: A student uses href="C:\Users\tom\style.css" on the live website. Problem?
ex.a:
1. Local path on his own PC; visitors don't have it.
  2. Upload the file and use a relative path or URL.
ex.az: 错：本机路径，访客无法读取。

cards.tz: 内部与外部样式表比较
cards.en:
Idea: Private notebook vs shared rule book.

InternalExternal
Where<style> in head.css + <link>
Reuseone pagemany pages
Consistencymay differconsistent
Maintenanceedit every pageedit one file
Loadingfasterextra request
Teamworkmixed in HTMLparallel

Exam wording: For a multi-page website, use an external style sheet so all pages share one file: consistent style and easier maintenance.
cards.zh:
直觉：私人笔记 vs 共用规则书。

InternalExternal
重用一页多页
维护逐页改改一个文件
载入较快多一次请求

考试写法：多页网站用 external：风格一致、易维护。

ex.q: One-page event poster site. Which?
ex.a:
1. Only one page; speed matters.
  2. Internal is fine.

ex.q: Company site with 200 pages. Which?
ex.a:
1. Many pages share look.
  2. External.

ex.q: A student says external style sheets always load faster. Correct?
ex.a:
1. Wrong: it needs an extra HTTP request.
  2. (Later pages may use the cached file.)

cards.en:
Idea: Like buying ready-made furniture instead of building each chair yourself.

A CSS framework gives predefined styling (components) for buttons, tables, lists. Examples: Bootstrap, W3.CSS.

  1. Link the framework's CSS (absolute path).
  2. Add its class names to elements.

Exam wording: Third-party CSS frameworks provide predefined styles; link their style sheet and add the specified class names to elements. This saves development time.
cards.zh:
直觉：像买现成家具，不用自己做每张椅子。

CSS 框架提供预设样式（components），如 Bootstrap、W3.CSS。

  1. 用 <link> 连接框架 CSS。
  2. 为元素加指定 class。

考试写法：连接框架样式表并加上指定 class 名，节省开发时间。

ex.q: Make a Bootstrap blue button.
ex.a:
1. Link Bootstrap CSS.
  2. <button class="btn btn-primary">OK</button>

ex.q: Give one advantage of a framework.
ex.a:
1. Predefined, tested styles.
  2. → saves development time, consistent look.

ex.q: A student adds class="btn btn-primary" but didn't link Bootstrap. Result?
ex.a:
1. No style: the classes have no rules.
  2. Link the framework's CSS first.
ex.az: 错：没连接 CSS，class 无作用。

code.src:
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap@5.3.3/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css">
<button type="button" class="btn btn-primary">Save</button>

notes.t: Link Bootstrap from a CDN (absolute path).
Use the framework's class names for a styled button.
notes.tz: 用框架 class 得到有样式的按钮。

cards.en:
Idea: A good remote control: same buttons in the same place, easy to find, clear what each does.

  • Consistent: same controls look/behave the same.
  • Easy to navigate: reach common functions fast (navigation bar).
  • Clear to users: show what was selected and results clearly.

Exams: draft a UI sketch with labelled controls; you don't need full CSS.

Exam wording: A good user interface should be consistent, easy to navigate and clear to users.
cards.zh:
直觉：好遥控器：按钮位置一致、易找、功能清楚。

  • Consistent 一致
  • Easy to navigate 易导航
  • Clear to users 清晰

考试写法：Consistent, easy to navigate, clear to users。

ex.q: Every page has the menu at the top. Which principle?
ex.a:
1. Same position on all pages.
  2. Consistent (and easy to navigate).

ex.q: After filtering, the chosen category is highlighted. Which principle?
ex.a:
1. User sees what is selected.
  2. Clear to users.

ex.q: A student's UI sketch has unlabelled boxes. Problem?
ex.a:
1. Lose marks: examiner can't tell control types.
  2. Label each: 'drop-down: district', 'button: Search'.

cards.tz: 例子：图书馆设施预约系统
cards.en:
Idea: Booking a study room should be as easy as choosing a seat in a cinema app.

  • Navigation bar: quick access.
  • Drop-down menus: branch, facility type.
  • Search button.
  • Clear results: which room and time slot are free.

Exam wording: Drop-down menus restrict choices to valid options and avoid typing errors; results clearly show available room and time slot.
cards.zh:
直觉：预约自修室应像戏院选座一样简单。

  • 导航栏
  • 下拉选单：分馆、设施类别
  • 搜索按钮
  • 清楚显示空房和时段

考试写法：下拉选单限制为有效选项，避免打错。

ex.q: Why a drop-down for branch instead of a text box?

ex.q: Write one rule: all <h2> centred, navy, 20px.
ex.a: 1. h2 { text-align: center; color: navy; font-size: 20px; }
ex.az: h2 { text-align: center; color: navy; font-size: 20px; }

ex.q: <p class="a" id="b" style="color:green"> with .a{color:red} #b{color:blue}. Colour?
ex.a: 1. Inline highest → green.

ex.q: Spot the error: .note { colour: red; text-align: centre }
ex.a: 1. colour → color, centre → center.

mc.q: Which best describes the role of CSS?
o: Defines the structure and content of a web page
Controls the appearance and presentation of HTML elements
Runs scripts on the web server
mc.e: CSS separates presentation from content; HTML gives structure and content.
mc.ez: CSS 控制外观，HTML 负责结构与内容。

mc.q: Which is NOT a limitation of inline styles?
o: Requires an extra file request when loading
mc.e: An extra request for a .css file is a drawback of external style sheets.
mc.ez: 额外请求 .css 是 external style sheet 的缺点。

mc.q: In a web page, how HTML elements are nested inside each other (e.g. <tr> inside <table>) is called its
mc.e: Structure = how elements are nested.

mc.q: Which of the following is 'content' of a web page?
mc.e: Content = texts, images and links.

mc.q: <p style="color:blue; text-align:center"> What separates the two declarations?
mc.e: Declarations are separated by semicolons; property and value by a colon.

mc.q: A page has 12 girls' names in <li> elements, each with the same long inline style. The colour must change from red to pink. Which limitation does this show most directly?
mc.e: Every element must be edited by hand: reduced maintainability.
mc.ez: 要逐个修改：可维护性降低。

mc.q: Making a website usable by people with different abilities is called
mc.e: Universal design = usable by people with different abilities.
mc.ez: Universal design 让不同能力的人都能使用。

mc.q: In the CSS box model, each HTML element is rendered as
mc.e: Every element is an invisible box containing its content.
mc.ez: 每个元素都是看不见的 box。

mc.q: In h1 { color: red; }, h1 is the
mc.e: The part before { } is the selector.

mc.q: In color: #6A567F;, #6A567F is the
mc.e: property: value. #6A567F is the value.

mc.q: Which CSS rule is written correctly?
mc.e: Curly brackets, colon between property and value, semicolons between declarations.

mc.q: Which selector is an element-wise (type) selector?
mc.e: Element selector = a valid HTML element name with no symbol. 'menu-item' is not an HTML element.
mc.ez: table 是合法元素名且无符号。

mc.q: Which symbol starts an ID selector?
mc.e: ID selector starts with #.

mc.q: Which statement about the id attribute is correct?
o: Several elements on a page may share the same id
Each id must be unique within a web page
An element can have several ids separated by spaces
The id value must start with #
mc.e: id is a unique identifier within one document; # is only used in CSS.
mc.ez: 同一网页内 id 必须唯一。

mc.q: Which is a valid class name for 'science teacher'?
mc.e: Class names cannot contain spaces; use hyphen or underscore.
mc.ez: class 名不能有空格，用连字符或下划线。

mc.q: <li class="girl senior"> means the element
o: has two classes, girl and senior
has id girl and class senior
mc.e: Multiple classes are separated by spaces.

mc.q: CSS: h1{text-decoration:underline} .benefit{color:green}. HTML: <h1>Energy</h1><li>Nuclear</li><li class="benefit">Solar</li>. Which text is underlined?
mc.e: Only the h1 matches the h1 selector.

mc.q: Which selector applies a style to many different kinds of elements that share a label?
mc.e: A class can be added to any number of elements of any type.
mc.ez: class 可加在任何多个元素上。

mc.q: To style one <h1 id="name">, which is correct?
mc.e: ID selector uses # + id.
mc.ez: ID selector 是 # 加 id。

mc.q: Which value is NOT a valid way to write a colour for color?
mc.e: rgb() has three parts, each 0–255.

mc.q: #FFFFFF as a text colour is
mc.e: All three channels at maximum = white.

mc.q: What is #33FF00 in rgb() form?
font-family: "Courier New", Georgia, monospace; On a computer with Georgia but not Courier New installed (and it cannot be downloaded), which font is used?
mc.e: The browser uses the first font in the list that is installed or downloadable.
mc.ez: 用列表中第一个可用的字体。

mc.q: Which is NOT a generic font family used as a fall-back?
mc.e: Arial is a specific font, not a generic family.

mc.q: Which property makes text bold?
mc.e: font-weight sets boldness.

mc.q: Which property underlines text?
mc.e: text-decoration: underline. 'font-decoration' (a misprint in the book's summary) does not exist.
mc.ez: 是 text-decoration；课本 summary 的 font-decoration 是错的。

mc.q: Which is NOT a valid value of text-align?
mc.e: Valid: left, right, center, justify.

mc.q: What is the space between an element's content and its border called?
mc.e: Padding is inside the border, around the content.
mc.ez: padding 是内容与边框之间。

mc.q: What is the distance between an element and the edge of the web page (left/right) controlled by?
mc.e: Margin = space outside the border, to other elements or the page edge.
mc.ez: margin 控制元素与页面边缘距离。

mc.q: Order the box model from inside to outside.
mc.e: content → padding → border → margin.

mc.q: A <p> has a yellow background, padding 20px and margin 20px. Which area is yellow?
mc.e: Background covers content and padding, not margin.
mc.ez: 背景色覆盖内容和 padding。

mc.q: By default, an element's border is
o: the same colour as the background
mc.e: Borders are invisible until set.

mc.q: In border: solid red 2px;, what does 2px set?
mc.e: Style, colour and width can be written together.

mc.q: list-style has a visible effect on which element?
mc.e: list-style only affects <ul> and <ol>.

mc.q: Which pair of properties sets the size of an element's box?
mc.e: height and width.

mc.q: p { colour: red; } in a real browser makes paragraph text
mc.e: 'colour' is not a CSS property; it is ignored and the default black is used.
mc.ez: colour 无效被忽略，仍是默认黑色。

mc.q: A web page changes from plain left-aligned heading to an underlined, centred heading with a coloured background. Which properties changed?
mc.e: Underline → text-decoration; centred → text-align; background → background-color.

mc.q: Which has the HIGHEST specificity?
mc.e: Inline > ID > class > element.

mc.q: Which has the LOWEST specificity?
mc.e: Element-wise selectors are lowest.

mc.q: CSS: #intro{color:red} .highlight{color:blue}. HTML: <h1 id="intro" class="highlight">. Text colour?
mc.e: ID beats class regardless of order.

mc.q: CSS: .intro{color:green} .highlight{color:red}. HTML: <p class="highlight intro">. Text colour?
mc.e: Same specificity: the rule defined later (.highlight) wins; order in the class attribute does not matter.
mc.ez: 同级看 CSS 先后，.highlight 在后。

mc.q: CSS: #intro{color:red;border:solid}. HTML: <p id="intro" style="color:LightSeaGreen">. Which is correct?
o: LightSeaGreen text with a solid border
Red text with a solid border
mc.e: Inline wins only for color; border is not in conflict and still applies.
mc.ez: inline 只覆盖 color，border 仍生效。

mc.q: CSS: p{color:blue;font-size:15px}. HTML: <p style="background-color:lightblue;font-size:30px">Hi</p>. Font colour and size?
mc.e: Colour from p (no conflict); size from inline style.
mc.ez: 颜色来自 p，大小来自 inline。

mc.q: CSS: h1{color:#FFFFFF;font-size:15px}. HTML: <h1 style="background-color:darkslateblue;text-align:center">ABC Store</h1>. Font colour of 'ABC Store'?
mc.e: #FFFFFF = white; the inline style does not set color.

mc.q: CSS: .popular{color:goldenrod} .cheap{border:solid red 2px}. HTML: <p class="cheap">Vietnam</p>. Text colour?
mc.e: No rule sets color for this element; default black.
mc.ez: 没有规则设 color，默认黑。

mc.q: CSS: #description{font-size:25px} p{font-size:10px}. HTML: <p id="description">Locations</p>. Font size?
mc.e: ID beats element.

mc.q: CSS: #title{color:red} p{color:blue;font-size:10px}. <p id="title"> is changed to <h1 id="title">. What happens?
o: Colour stays red; size/weight change to h1 defaults
mc.e: p no longer matches, so 10px is lost; #title still makes it red.
mc.ez: p 不再匹配，失去 10px；#title 仍红。

mc.q: When an ID selector overrides a class selector for an element, which declarations of the class are ignored?
o: Only those setting the same properties as the ID rule
mc.e: Only conflicting properties are overridden.

mc.q: Where is the best place to put an internal style sheet?
mc.e: Best practice: <style> in <head> for readability.

mc.q: Which correctly links an external style sheet?
mc.e: <link> with rel="stylesheet" and href.

mc.q: What does rel="stylesheet" tell the browser?
o: The path of the CSS file
That the linked file is a CSS style sheet
mc.e: rel states the relationship: a style sheet.
mc.ez: rel 说明链接的是样式表。

mc.q: An advantage of an internal style sheet over an external one is
o: it can be reused by many pages
faster loading because no extra file is requested
mc.e: Internal: no extra request, so faster loading.
mc.ez: 无需额外请求，加载较快。

mc.q: Which is an advantage of an external style sheet?
o: It can only be used by one page
It has higher specificity than inline styles
mc.e: One sheet for many pages gives consistent style and easier maintenance.

mc.q: href="https://www.bootbelt.net/coolStyle.css" is an example of
mc.e: A full URL is an absolute path, typical for third-party CSS on another domain.
mc.ez: 完整 URL 是绝对路径。

mc.q: To use a Bootstrap button style, you need to
o: only link the Bootstrap style sheet
link the Bootstrap style sheet AND add the specified class names
write the CSS for buttons yourself
mc.e: Both steps are required.
mc.ez: 要引入样式表并加 class。

mc.q: The predefined looks offered by frameworks such as W3.CSS are called
mc.e: Predefined appearances are called components.

mc.q: A user must be able to search sports facilities in more than one district at a time. The best input control is
mc.e: Checkboxes allow multiple selections from predefined options.

mc.q: Replacing a text box for 'District' with a drop-down menu mainly avoids
o: the need for a search button
mc.e: Choosing from valid options prevents typos.

mc.q: One advantage of a grid layout over a list layout for search results is
o: more items shown at the same time
mc.e: Grid: more items at once; list: more info per item.
mc.ez: 网格可同时显示更多项目。

mc.q: Which is the most suitable control for choosing a booking date?
o: Radio buttons for every day of the year
mc.e: A calendar picker (or day/month/year drop-downs).

mc.q: In an online shop catalogue, which feature helps users know what they are viewing after filtering?
o: Showing the currently selected category clearly
mc.e: The book stresses clearly showing the selected category.
mc.ez: 清楚显示当前所选类别。

pr.taskz: <head> 里用两个 <link> 分别连接 style.css（相对路径）和 Bootstrap（绝对路径），不要 <style>；body 里一个 Join 按钮，class 为 btn btn-primary。
pr.solution:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="style.css">
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/bootstrap.min.css">
</head>
<body>
  <button type="button" class="btn btn-primary">Join</button>
</body>
</html>

pr.taskz: 写 hexToRgb(hex)：把 "#FF8833" 这类 6 位十六进制颜色转成 "rgb(255,136,51)"（无空格）。
