cards.t: Chapter overview: why connect to a database
cards.tz: 本章定位：为什么要连接数据库
cards.en:
Intuition: a PHP page without a database is like a shop with no storeroom. It can serve you, but it forgets everything when you leave.

In Chapter 3 a form sent data to PHP, but nothing was stored permanently. A database (an organised store of tables) keeps data after the page ends.

  • Store: usernames, products, bookings, posts.
  • Retrieve: show them on later pages, to any user.

Real examples: booking system, discussion forum, online shop, online survey.

Exam wording: The web server connects to a database so that data can be stored permanently and retrieved to generate dynamic web pages.
cards.zh:
直觉：没有数据库的 PHP 网页就像没有仓库的商店，客人走了就什么都忘了。

第 3 章表单把资料送到 PHP，但没有永久保存。database（有组织的表格集合）可以在网页结束后仍保存资料。

  • 储存：用户名、产品、预约、帖子。
  • 读取：之后在其他页面给任何用户显示。

例子：预约系统、讨论区、网店、网上问卷。

考试写法：The web server connects to a database so that data can be stored permanently and retrieved to generate dynamic web pages.

ex.q: A student says: 'I can keep forum posts in a PHP variable.' Explain why this fails.
ex.a:
1. A PHP variable only lives while the script runs for one request.
2. When the next user loads the page, the script starts again and the variable is empty.
3. So posts must be saved in a database, which stores data permanently.
ex.az:
1. PHP 变量只在本次请求执行期间存在。
2. 下一个用户打开页面时脚本重新执行，变量是空的。
3. 所以帖子要存进 database。

ex.q: Name two web applications that need a database and say what each stores.
ex.a:
1. Booking system: stores rooms, dates and who booked.
2. Online shop: stores products, prices and orders.
ex.az:
1. 预约系统：房间、日期、预约人。
2. 网店：产品、价钱、订单。

ex.q: Which part of a web app stores data, and which part makes the HTML?
ex.a:
1. The database stores data.
2. The server-side script (PHP on the web server) reads the data and generates the HTML.
ex.az:
1. database 储存资料。
2. web server 上的 PHP 读取资料并生成 HTML。

cards.en:
Intuition: SQL is the language PHP uses to ask the database for data. PHP just sends the SQL text.

Order of clauses:

SELECT cols FROM table
WHERE row_condition
GROUP BY col HAVING group_condition
ORDER BY col DESC;
  • AS gives an alias (new column name): COUNT(*) AS n. In PHP you read $row["n"].
  • WHERE filters rows; HAVING filters groups.
  • BETWEEN a AND b includes both ends.
  • Text values need quotes 'Asian'; numbers do not.

Exam wording: WHERE filters records before grouping; HAVING filters groups after GROUP BY.
cards.zh:
直觉：SQL 是 PHP 用来“问”数据库要资料的语言，PHP 只是把 SQL 文字送出去。

子句次序：SELECT → FROM → WHERE → GROUP BY → HAVING → ORDER BY。

  • AS 设定 alias：COUNT(*) AS n，PHP 中用 $row["n"]。
  • WHERE 过滤行；HAVING 过滤组。
  • BETWEEN a AND b 包括两端。
  • 文字要加引号，数字不用。

考试写法：WHERE filters records before grouping; HAVING filters groups after GROUP BY.

ex.q: Count restaurants on each floor, showing only floors with 2 or more.
ex.a:
1. Group by floor: GROUP BY floor.
2. Count each group with an alias: COUNT(*) AS n.
3. Filter groups: HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2.
SELECT floor, COUNT(*) AS n FROM restaurants
GROUP BY floor HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2;
Result: floor 2 → 2, floor 3 → 2.
ex.az: 按 floor 分组，COUNT(*) AS n，再用 HAVING 过滤。结果：2 楼 2 间，3 楼 2 间。

ex.q: Wrong: SELECT floor, COUNT(*) FROM restaurants WHERE COUNT(*) >= 2 GROUP BY floor;
ex.a:
1. WHERE runs before grouping, so COUNT(*) does not exist yet. This is an error.
2. Fix: move the condition to HAVING after GROUP BY.
ex.az: WHERE 在分组前执行，不能用 COUNT(*)。改用 HAVING。

ex.q: List Asian restaurants on floors 2 to 3, by name.
ex.a:
SELECT name FROM restaurants
WHERE category = 'Asian' AND floor BETWEEN 2 AND 3
ORDER BY name;
BETWEEN includes 2 and 3. Result: Dim Sum Hall, Sushi Go.
ex.az: BETWEEN 包含 2 和 3。结果：Dim Sum Hall、Sushi Go。

code.src:
SELECT floor, COUNT(*) AS n
FROM restaurants
GROUP BY floor
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2;

notes.t: Show the floor and the number of rows in each group, named n.
notes.tz: 显示楼层和每组行数，命名为 n。

notes.t: Keep only groups with 2 or more rows.
notes.tz: 只保留 2 行或以上的组。

code.setup: CREATE TABLE restaurants(code INTEGER, name TEXT, category TEXT, floor INTEGER); INSERT INTO restaurants VALUES (1001,'Noodle House','Asian',1),(1002,'Pasta Bar','Western',2),(2003,'Sushi Go','Asian',2),(2004,'Burger Hub','Western',3),(3005,'Dim Sum Hall','Asian',3);

demo.setup: CREATE TABLE restaurants(code INTEGER, name TEXT, category TEXT, floor INTEGER); INSERT INTO restaurants VALUES (1001,'Noodle House','Asian',1),(1002,'Pasta Bar','Western',2),(2003,'Sushi Go','Asian',2),(2004,'Burger Hub','Western',3),(3005,'Dim Sum Hall','Asian',3);
demo.query: SELECT floor, COUNT(*) AS n FROM restaurants GROUP BY floor HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2;
demo.note: Floor 1 has only 1 restaurant, so HAVING removes it.

cards.en:
Intuition: an ORM is a translator. You talk in objects (your programming language); it talks SQL to the database for you.

ORM = a technique where tables map to classes and rows map to objects. Calling a method like Restaurant::where('floor', 2) makes the ORM write the SQL.

  • Benefit: less SQL to write, focus on application logic, code works with different DBMSs.
  • Cost: hides the SQL, may be slower for complex queries, more to learn.
  • Examples: Laravel Eloquent (PHP), Django ORM (Python).

Exam wording: ORM provides an abstraction layer between an object-oriented language and a relational database, so developers manipulate records through objects instead of writing SQL.
cards.zh:
直觉：ORM 是翻译员：你用 object（程序语言）说话，它替你跟数据库讲 SQL。

ORM：table 对应 class，row 对应 object。调用 Restaurant::where('floor', 2)，ORM 自动生成 SQL。

  • 好处：少写 SQL，专注应用逻辑，可换 DBMS。
  • 坏处：隐藏 SQL，复杂查询可能较慢，要另外学习。
  • 例子：Laravel Eloquent、Django ORM。

考试写法：ORM provides an abstraction layer between an object-oriented language and a relational database...

ex.q: In an ORM, what does one row of table students become?
ex.a: One object of the class Student; its columns become the object's attributes (e.g. $s->name).
ex.az: 变成 Student class 的一个 object，栏位变成属性。

ex.q: A student writes: 'ORM means there is no database any more.' Correct it.
ex.a:
1. Wrong: the relational database still stores the data.
2. The ORM only generates the SQL for you behind the scenes.
ex.az: 错：数据库仍然存在，ORM 只是在背后替你生成 SQL。

ex.q: Give one advantage and one disadvantage of ORM.
ex.a:
Advantage: developers write less SQL and focus on application logic.
Disadvantage: generated SQL may be less efficient, and it is harder to see what really runs.
ex.az: 好处：少写 SQL；坏处：生成的 SQL 可能效率较低，较难看清实际执行的 SQL。

cards.t: Web server and database: two separate entities
cards.tz: Web server 与 database 是两个独立实体
cards.en:
Intuition: the web server is a waiter; the database is the kitchen. Customers (browsers) only talk to the waiter.

  • Browser ↔ web server: HTTP requests and responses.
  • Web server ↔ database: an API (e.g. mysqli functions).

They are separate programs that work independently and may be on different machines. The browser never talks to the database directly, so users cannot see the PHP, the SQL or the database password, only the final HTML.

Exam wording: The web server and the database are two separate entities; the web server communicates with the database through an API, while the client communicates with the web server through HTTP.
cards.zh:
直觉：web server 是侍应，database 是厨房。客人（浏览器）只跟侍应说话。

  • 浏览器 ↔ web server：HTTP request / response。
  • web server ↔ database：API（如 mysqli 函数）。

两者是独立程序，可在不同机器上。浏览器从不直接连数据库，所以用户看不到 PHP、SQL、数据库密码，只看到 HTML。

考试写法：The web server and the database are two separate entities; ... API ... HTTP.

ex.q: Can a user see the SQL used to build a page with 'View Source'? Why?
ex.a:
1. No.
2. The SQL is inside the PHP script, which runs on the server.
3. The browser receives only the resulting HTML.
ex.az: 不能。SQL 在服务器上的 PHP 里，浏览器只收到 HTML。

ex.q: Wrong: 'The browser sends SQL to the database through HTTP.'
ex.a:
1. The browser only sends an HTTP request to the web server.
2. The PHP script sends the SQL to the database through the API.
ex.az: 浏览器只向 web server 发 HTTP request；由 PHP 经 API 发 SQL。

ex.q: State the protocol/method used on each link: browser–web server, web server–database.
ex.a: Browser–web server: HTTP. Web server–database: an API such as mysqli.

demo.title: One page request with a database

frames.en: The browser asks for list_restaurants.php (URL + method GET).
The web server runs the PHP script. The script calls mysqli_query(), which sends an SQL query to the database through the API.
frames.zh: Web server 执行 PHP；脚本调用 mysqli_query()，通过 API 把 SQL 发给数据库。

frames.en: The database runs the SQL and sends the query result (rows) back to the web server.
frames.zh: 数据库执行 SQL，把 query result（若干行）传回 web server。

frames.en: PHP loops through the rows, echoes HTML, and the web server sends this HTML back. The browser never sees the PHP, the SQL or the password.
frames.zh: PHP 逐行输出 HTML，web server 把 HTML 回传。浏览器看不到 PHP、SQL 和密码。

cards.t: The 4-step flow: request → query → result → HTML
cards.en:
Intuition: order food → waiter tells kitchen → kitchen gives dish → waiter serves it.

  1. Client: browser sends an HTTP request (URL + method).
  2. Server: web server runs the PHP script, which sends an SQL query through the API.
  3. Database: runs the query and returns the query result.
  4. Server: PHP uses the result to generate HTML, sent back as the HTTP response.

Press Next in the demo to watch it.

Exam wording: The server-side script sends an SQL query to the database; the database returns the query result; the script generates an HTML document from the result and returns it to the client.
cards.zh:
直觉：点菜 → 侍应通知厨房 → 厨房出菜 → 侍应上菜。

  1. 客户端：浏览器发 HTTP request。
  2. 服务器：执行 PHP，经 API 发 SQL query。
  3. 数据库：执行并返回 query result。
  4. 服务器：PHP 用结果生成 HTML，作为 HTTP response 回传。

考试写法：同英文。

ex.q: Put in order: (A) database returns result (B) browser sends request (C) HTML sent to browser (D) PHP sends SQL.
ex.a: B → D → A → C.

ex.q: Wrong: 'Step 4: the database sends HTML to the browser.'
ex.a:
1. The database only returns data (rows), never HTML.
2. The PHP script on the web server turns the rows into HTML and the web server sends it.
ex.az: 数据库只返回资料；HTML 由 web server 上的 PHP 生成。

ex.q: Which steps happen on the server side?
ex.a: Steps 2 and 4 (running the script, sending SQL, generating HTML). Step 3 is on the database side, step 1 on the client side.
ex.az: 第 2、4 步在服务器端；第 3 步在数据库端；第 1 步在客户端。

demo.title: One page request with a database

frames.en: The browser asks for list_restaurants.php (URL + method GET).
The web server runs the PHP script. The script calls mysqli_query(), which sends an SQL query to the database through the API.
frames.zh: Web server 执行 PHP；脚本调用 mysqli_query()，通过 API 把 SQL 发给数据库。

frames.en: The database runs the SQL and sends the query result (rows) back to the web server.
frames.zh: 数据库执行 SQL，把 query result（若干行）传回 web server。

frames.en: PHP loops through the rows, echoes HTML, and the web server sends this HTML back. The browser never sees the PHP, the SQL or the password.
frames.zh: PHP 逐行输出 HTML，web server 把 HTML 回传。浏览器看不到 PHP、SQL 和密码。

cards.en:
Intuition: an API is like a menu. You order by name; you don't need to know how the kitchen cooks.

An API lets one program use services of another program through a set of defined functions, without knowing how they work inside.

  • Online shop → payment (credit card) API.
  • Courier → map API to show a parcel.
  • News site → weather API from the Observatory.
  • PHP → mysqli API to use a MySQL database.

Exam wording: An API allows a program to use the services of another program through defined functions; it saves development time because developers do not need to build the service themselves.
cards.zh:
直觉：API 像餐牌：按名字点菜，不用知道厨房怎样煮。

API 让一个程序通过定义好的函数使用另一个程序的服务，毋须知道内部运作。

  • 网店 → 信用卡付款 API
  • 速递 → 地图 API
  • 新闻网 → 天文台天气 API
  • PHP → mysqli

考试写法：An API allows a program to use the services of another program ... saves development time.

ex.q: Why would a school website use a weather API instead of measuring weather itself?
ex.a:
1. It saves development time and cost.
2. The weather provider's data is more accurate and up to date.
3. The developer only calls the API functions.
ex.az: 省时省钱，数据更准，只需调用 API。

ex.q: Wrong: 'An API is a kind of database.'
ex.a: An API is an interface (set of functions) for using another program's services. mysqli is the API; MySQL is the database.
ex.az: API 是接口（一组函数），不是数据库。mysqli 是 API，MySQL 才是数据库。

ex.q: In this chapter, which API connects the web server to MySQL, and name two of its functions.
ex.a: mysqli; e.g. mysqli_connect() and mysqli_query().

cards.t: mysqli and its three most common functions
cards.tz: mysqli 与三个最常用函数
cards.en:
Intuition: three steps like a phone call: dial (connect), ask (query), listen to each answer (fetch).

FunctionJobReturns
mysqli_connect()Connect web server to databasemysqli object / false
mysqli_query()Run one SQL statementresult object / true / false
mysqli_fetch_assoc()Get the next row as an associative arrayarray / NULL

⚠ mysqli works only with MySQL (and MariaDB). PostgreSQL, SQLite, MongoDB need other APIs.

Exam wording: mysqli_connect() establishes the connection; mysqli_query() executes an SQL query; mysqli_fetch_assoc() fetches one row of the result as an associative array.
cards.zh:
直觉：像打电话：拨号（connect）、发问（query）、逐句听答案（fetch）。

函数作用返回
mysqli_connect()连接数据库mysqli object / false
mysqli_query()执行 SQLresult object / true / false
mysqli_fetch_assoc()取下一行成 associative arrayarray / NULL

⚠ mysqli 只能连 MySQL。

考试写法：同英文。

ex.q: Write the three calls, in order, to show all restaurant names.
ex.a:
$link = mysqli_connect($s, $u, $p, $d);
$result = mysqli_query($link, "SELECT name FROM restaurants");
while ($row = mysqli_fetch_assoc($result)) { echo $row["name"] . "<br>"; }

ex.q: Wrong: using mysqli_connect() for an SQLite database file.
ex.a: mysqli only works with MySQL. SQLite needs another API (e.g. PDO or SQLite3 class).
ex.az: mysqli 只支援 MySQL，SQLite 要用其他 API。

ex.q: Which function would you call 5 times if the result has 4 rows? Why 5?
ex.a: mysqli_fetch_assoc(): 4 calls return the 4 rows, the 5th returns NULL and ends the while loop.
ex.az: fetch_assoc 调用 5 次：4 次取行，第 5 次返回 NULL 结束循环。

notes.t: Step 1: connect; keep the ticket in $link.
notes.tz: 第 1 步：连接，门票存入 $link。

notes.t: Step 2: run SQL using the ticket.
notes.tz: 第 2 步：用门票执行 SQL。

notes.t: Step 3: take one row at a time until NULL.
notes.tz: 第 3 步：逐行取出直到 NULL。

notes.t: Print the name column of this row.

code.out:
Noodle House
Pasta Bar
Sushi Go
Burger Hub
Dim Sum Hall

cards.t: API functions vs built-in functions: error catching
cards.tz: API 函数 vs 内置函数：要做错误处理
cards.en:
Intuition: adding numbers in your head rarely fails; phoning someone can fail (no signal, line busy).

Built-inAPI (e.g. mysqli)
Examplesisset(), empty(), strlen()mysqli_connect(), mysqli_query()
Runsinside the PHP interpreterwith network communication to another program
Risk of failurelowhigh (database offline, wrong password, firewall)

So after an API call, check the return value and handle failure, e.g. with die().

Exam wording: API functions involve behind-the-scenes operations and network communication, so there is a higher risk of failure; developers should implement error-catching mechanisms.
cards.zh:
直觉：心算很少出错；打电话却可能没讯号、占线。

内置函数API 函数
例子isset()、strlen()mysqli_connect()
执行PHP 解释器内需网络通讯
失败风险低高

API 调用后要检查返回值并处理失败（如 die()）。

考试写法：API functions involve network communication, so ... implement error-catching mechanisms.

ex.q: Give two reasons mysqli_query() might fail but strlen() would not.
ex.a:
1. The database server could be offline or the connection lost.
2. The SQL may have a syntax error or refer to a missing table.
strlen() only works on a string in memory.
ex.az: 数据库离线/断线；SQL 语法错误或表不存在。strlen() 只处理内存中的字符串。

ex.q: Wrong code: $link = mysqli_connect(...); $r = mysqli_query($link, $q); with no check.
ex.a:
1. If the connection fails, $link is false and the next call crashes with a confusing error.
2. Fix: if (!$link) { die("Cannot connect"); } right after connecting.
ex.az: 没检查返回值，连接失败时下一句出错。应加 if (!$link) die()。

ex.q: What does 'error-catching mechanism' mean here?
ex.a: Code that checks if a function failed (e.g. returned false) and responds safely: show a friendly message, stop the script, or log the error.
ex.az: 检查函数是否失败（返回 false），然后安全处理：显示信息、停止脚本或记录。

cards.en:
Intuition: to enter a building you need: address, name, password, and which room.

$link = mysqli_connect(host, username, password, database);
  1. Hostname of the database server (e.g. 'localhost', 'db.mysite.net')
  2. Username of the database account
  3. Password
  4. Database name

Optional 5th: port (default 3306). The order is fixed.

Good practice: put each value in a variable first, then pass the variables: easier to read and to change.

Exam wording: mysqli_connect() takes the hostname of the database server, the username, the password and the database name, and returns a mysqli object if successful.
cards.zh:
直觉：进大厦要：地址、名字、密码、哪个房间。

  1. Hostname 数据库服务器
  2. Username
  3. Password
  4. Database 名

第 5 个可选：port（预设 3306）。次序固定。

良好习惯：先存入变量再传入，易读易改。

考试写法：mysqli_connect() takes the hostname ..., username, password and database name, and returns a mysqli object if successful.

ex.q: Connect to database school on host db.abcss.edu.hk with account web01 / pw123.
ex.a:
$link = mysqli_connect('db.abcss.edu.hk', 'web01', 'pw123', 'school');
Order: host, user, password, database.

ex.q: Wrong: mysqli_connect('school', 'localhost', 'web01', 'pw123');
ex.a: The order is wrong: database name was put first. PHP treats 'school' as the hostname and the connection fails. Correct order: host, username, password, database.
ex.az: 次序错，'school' 被当成 hostname，连接失败。

ex.q: The MySQL server listens on port 3307. Write the call.
ex.a:
$link = mysqli_connect('localhost', 'web01', 'pw123', 'school', 3307);
The port is the 5th parameter.

code.src:
<?php
$server   = 'localhost';
$username = 'web_server_01';
$password = 'CastleInTheSky';
$database = 'afflatus_mall';
$link = mysqli_connect($server, $username, $password, $database);
if (!$link) {
  die("ERROR: Webserver could not connect to database!");
}
?>

notes.tz: 数据库服务器的主机名。

notes.t: Database account name (for the web server, not a user).
notes.tz: 数据库账户名（属于 web server，不是网站用户）。

notes.t: Name of the database to use.
Connect. Returns a mysqli object (the 'ticket') or false.
notes.tz: 连接。成功返回 mysqli object（门票），失败返回 false。

notes.t: If $link is false, the connection failed.
notes.tz: 若 $link 是 false，表示连接失败。

notes.t: Print a message and stop the whole script.
notes.tz: 输出信息并终止整个脚本。

code.out:
(no output if the connection succeeds)
ERROR: Webserver could not connect to database!   ← if it fails

cards.t: Database server, accounts and access control
cards.tz: 数据库服务器、账户与访问控制
cards.en:
Intuition: a database server is a library building; each database is a room; each web server has its own library card.

  • One database server can host many databases, each with its own tables (e.g. afflatus_mall: restaurants, floors, wage).
  • End users rarely connect directly; the web server runs the queries for them.
  • Each web server has an account (username + password), often one account per web server.
  • No valid credentials → cannot connect: this is user access control.

Exam wording: Multiple databases can be hosted on a single database server; each web server uses its own account so that access can be controlled.
cards.zh:
直觉：数据库服务器是图书馆大楼，每个 database 是一个房间，每台 web server 有自己的借书证。

  • 一台 database server 可放多个 database。
  • 终端用户很少直接连接，由 web server 代为查询。
  • 每台 web server 有自己的账户。
  • 没有正确 credentials 不能连接：user access control。

考试写法：同英文。

ex.q: Two websites (shop and staff portal) share one database server. Suggest an account setup.
ex.a:
1. Create two databases (shop, staff).
2. Give each web server its own account.
3. The shop account can only access the shop database, so a hacked shop cannot read staff data.
ex.az: 两个 database，两个账户，各自只能存取自己的 database。

ex.q: Wrong: 'Every customer of the online shop gets a MySQL account.'
ex.a: Customers do not connect to MySQL. Only the web server has an account. Customer logins are rows in a users table.
ex.az: 顾客不直接连 MySQL；只有 web server 有账户。顾客登入资料只是 users 表的记录。

ex.q: What is user access control?
ex.a: Only users (accounts) with valid credentials can connect; others are refused.
ex.az: 只有拥有正确 credentials 的账户才能连接。

cards.t: Authentication vs authorisation of database accounts
cards.tz: 数据库账户：authentication 与 authorisation
cards.en:
Intuition: showing your ID card at the gate is authentication; which rooms the card opens is authorisation.

AuthenticationAuthorisation
QuestionWho are you?What can you do?
Howusername + password when connectingpermissions given to the account
Exampleweb_server_01 logs inweb_server_01 may only SELECT

Principle of least privilege: a web server that only displays data should get data retrieval permission only. If it is hacked, the attacker cannot insert, change or delete data.

Exam wording: Authentication verifies the identity of the account; authorisation controls what operations the account is allowed to perform.
cards.zh:
直觉：在门口出示证件是 authentication；证件能开哪些房间是 authorisation。

AuthenticationAuthorisation
问题你是谁？你可以做什么？
方法连接时检查用户名密码给账户的权限

最少权限：只显示资料的 web server 只给 SELECT 权限。

考试写法：同英文。

ex.q: A news site only shows articles. What permission should its web server account have, and why?
ex.a:
1. SELECT (data retrieval) only.
2. If the web server is attacked, the attacker cannot change or delete articles.
ex.az: 只给 SELECT；被入侵时也不能改或删资料。

ex.q: Wrong: 'Authorisation means checking the password.'
ex.a: Checking the password is authentication. Authorisation is deciding what the account may do after login.
ex.az: 检查密码是 authentication；authorisation 是登入后能做什么。

ex.q: Classify: (a) login rejected for wrong password (b) DELETE refused for account web01.
ex.a: (a) authentication failed. (b) authorisation: web01 lacks DELETE permission.

cards.en:
ValueMeaning
'localhost' / '127.0.0.1'Database is on the same machine as the web server; common in development (e.g. XAMPP)
'root'Account with the highest admin rights (can drop databases, change tables). Using it on a live server is very poor security; only for local testing.
3306Default port of MySQL. Only give a port if it is different.

Intuition: 'localhost' = 'this computer'; root = master key.

Exam wording: 'localhost' means the database server is hosted on the same machine as the web server; using the root account in production is a security risk because it has full administrative rights.
cards.zh:
值意思
'localhost' / '127.0.0.1'数据库与 web server 在同一部机，开发时常用（XAMPP）
'root'最高管理权限账户；正式网站用它是极差的保安做法
3306MySQL 预设端口

直觉：localhost =“这部电脑”；root = 万能钥匙。

考试写法：同英文。

ex.q: Explain mysqli_connect('localhost','root','','test').
ex.a:
1. Database is on the same machine.
2. Uses the admin account root.
3. Empty password (XAMPP default).
4. Database 'test'. Fine for local testing only.
ex.az: 同一部机、root 账户、空密码、database test，只适合本地测试。

ex.q: Wrong: a live online shop connects with 'root'.
ex.a: If the PHP is hacked, the attacker gets full rights and can drop every database. Use a separate account with only the needed permissions.
ex.az: 被入侵会拥有全部权限，应用权限有限的独立账户。

ex.q: When must you pass a port number?
ex.a: Only when MySQL is not on the default port 3306, e.g. 3307: mysqli_connect($h,$u,$p,$d,3307).
ex.az: 只有不是 3306 时才要传。

cards.tz: mysqli_connect() 的返回值；object 概念
cards.en:
Intuition: the mysqli object is like a gym membership card: proof you are allowed in, shown every time you use a machine.

OutcomeReturns
Failfalse
Successa mysqli object (the connection)

Store it in a variable ($link/$conn) and pass it to every later mysqli call.

Primitive types (string, integer, float, Boolean) hold one value. An object holds its own data and functions, so it can represent something complex like a connection.

Exam wording: mysqli_connect() returns a mysqli object representing the connection if successful, or false if it fails; the object is stored and reused in later queries.
cards.zh:
直觉：mysqli object 像健身室会员证：证明你已获准进入，每次用器材都要出示。

结果返回
失败false
成功mysqli object

存进 $link，之后每次 mysqli 调用都传入。

Primitive types 只存一个值；object 有自己的资料和函数。

考试写法：同英文。

ex.q: Why store the result of mysqli_connect() in a variable?
ex.a: Because every later call (mysqli_query, mysqli_real_escape_string) needs this connection object. Storing it lets us reuse one connection.
ex.az: 之后每个调用都需要这个 object，存起来重复使用。

ex.q: Wrong: mysqli_query(mysqli_connect($h,$u,$p,$d), $q1); mysqli_query(mysqli_connect($h,$u,$p,$d), $q2);
ex.a: This opens a new connection for every query: slow and wasteful. Connect once, store in $link, reuse it.
ex.az: 每次查询都重新连接，又慢又浪费；连接一次存入 $link 重用。

ex.q: What is the data type of $link after a failed connection? After success?
ex.a: Failed: Boolean false. Success: a mysqli object.

cards.t: Why connections fail and how to handle it: die()
cards.tz: 连接失败原因与 die() 处理
cards.en:
Why it fails:

SideReasons
Web serverwrong username/password; wrong hostname or database name; firewall blocks the connection; wrong API used
Databaseserver offline; not on the default port

Handle it: test if (!$link) and call die(message), which prints the message and stops the script so no later code runs with a broken connection.

⚠ Show users a friendly message; do not print the password or technical details.

Exam wording: If mysqli_connect() returns false, die() outputs an error message and terminates the script.
cards.zh:
失败原因：

端原因
Web server用户名/密码错；hostname 或 database 名错；防火墙阻挡；用错 API
Database服务器离线；不在预设端口

处理：if (!$link) 时调用 die()，输出信息并终止脚本。

⚠ 只给用户友善信息，不要显示密码。

考试写法：同英文。

ex.q: List two web-server-side and one database-side reason for a failed connection.
ex.a: Web server: incorrect credentials; firewall blocks traffic. Database: server is offline.
ex.az: Web server：credentials 错、防火墙；Database：离线。

ex.q: Wrong: if ($link == true) { die("Error"); }
ex.a: The test is reversed: it stops the script when the connection succeeds. Use if (!$link).
ex.az: 条件相反，成功时反而停止。应 if (!$link)。

ex.q: What does the browser show if the connection fails in the code below, and does the <h1> after it appear?
ex.a: It shows 'ERROR: Webserver could not connect to database!'. Nothing after die() is sent, so the <h1> does not appear.
ex.az: 只显示错误信息；die() 之后的内容不输出。

code.src: Restaurant list

notes.tz: 数据库服务器的主机名。

notes.t: Database account name (for the web server, not a user).
notes.tz: 数据库账户名（属于 web server，不是网站用户）。

notes.t: Name of the database to use.
Connect. Returns a mysqli object (the 'ticket') or false.
notes.tz: 连接。成功返回 mysqli object（门票），失败返回 false。

notes.t: If $link is false, the connection failed.
notes.tz: 若 $link 是 false，表示连接失败。

notes.t: Print a message and stop the whole script.
notes.tz: 输出信息并终止整个脚本。

notes.t: HTML after PHP; only reached if connected.
notes.tz: 只有连接成功才会输出。

code.out: ERROR: Webserver could not connect to database!   (when the database is offline)

cards.t: Example 4.1: user login ≠ database connection; storing credentials
cards.tz: Example 4.1：用户登入不等于连接数据库；credentials 存放
cards.en:
Misconception: 'The username and password a user types are passed to mysqli_connect().'

Correct: users never connect to the database. The web server connects with its own credentials. The user's login is just a value in an SQL query:

SELECT * FROM users WHERE username = '...' AND password_hash = '...'

Store credentials in a separate config file (e.g. config.php, included with require):

  • Developers writing pages are isolated from the real password.
  • Change the password in one place.
  • Keep the file outside the public folder.

Exam wording: Database credentials belong to the web server, not to individual users; they should be stored in a separate configuration file.
cards.zh:
误解：用户输入的用户名密码会传给 mysqli_connect()。

正确：用户从不直接连数据库。web server 用自己的 credentials 连接；用户的登入资料只是 SQL 查询中的值。

把 credentials 放在独立 config 文件（如 config.php，用 require 引入）：

  • 开发者接触不到真正密码。
  • 只需改一处。
  • 放在公开文件夹以外。

考试写法：同英文。

ex.q: A user logs in as 'amy' / 'pa55'. Show how these are used.
ex.a:
1. PHP connects with the web server's own account.
2. Then runs SELECT * FROM users WHERE username = 'amy' and checks the password.
'amy' is only data in the query.
ex.az: 先用 web server 账户连接，再以 'amy' 作查询值。

ex.q: Wrong: mysqli_connect('localhost', $_POST['user'], $_POST['pass'], 'shop');
ex.a:
1. Every user would need a MySQL account.
2. Attackers could guess database accounts directly.
Fix: connect with fixed web server credentials from config.php; put the user's input in a WHERE clause (sanitised).
ex.az: 每个用户都要有 MySQL 账户，且被攻击者利用。应用固定 credentials。

ex.q: Give two reasons to store credentials in config.php.
ex.a:
1. Change them in one place for all pages.
2. Developers working on other pages do not see the credentials (isolation); the file can be kept out of the public web folder.
ex.az: 一处修改；开发者隔离、可放在公开目录外。

code.src:
<?php // config.php
$db_server = 'localhost';
$db_username = 'web_server_01';
$db_password = 'CastleInTheSky';
$db_database = 'afflatus_mall';
?>

notes.t: Separate file that only holds settings.

code.src:
<?php require 'config.php';
$link = mysqli_connect($db_server, $db_username, $db_password, $db_database);
if (!$link) { die("ERROR: Webserver could not connect to database!"); } ?>

notes.t: Load the four variables from config.php.
notes.tz: 载入 config.php 的四个变量。

cards.t: Executing SQL: two steps and quoting
cards.tz: 执行 SQL 的两步与引号写法
cards.en:
Intuition: first write your question on paper, then hand it to the librarian with your library card.

  1. Form the SQL as a PHP string and store it in a variable.
  2. Pass the ticket and the string to mysqli_query($link, $query).

Quoting rule: wrap the PHP string in double quotes and SQL text values in single quotes, so the two kinds of quotes don't clash:

$query = "SELECT * FROM restaurants WHERE category = 'Asian'";

Write column names in lowercase so they match $row['name'] later.

Exam wording: The SQL statement is formed as a string in the PHP script and executed by passing the connection object and the string to mysqli_query().
cards.zh:
直觉：先把问题写在纸上，再连同借书证交给图书馆员。

  1. 把 SQL 写成 PHP 字符串存入变量。
  2. 把门票和字符串传给 mysqli_query($link, $query)。

引号规则：PHP 字符串用双引号，SQL 文字值用单引号，避免冲突。

栏位名用小写，配合之后的 $row['name']。

考试写法：同英文。

ex.q: Write PHP to run: all Western restaurants on floor 2.
ex.a:
$query = "SELECT * FROM restaurants WHERE category = 'Western' AND floor = 2";
$result = mysqli_query($link, $query);
Text 'Western' in single quotes; number 2 without quotes. Result: Pasta Bar.
ex.az: 'Western' 用单引号，2 不用。结果 Pasta Bar。

ex.q: Wrong: $query = "SELECT * FROM restaurants WHERE category = "Asian"";
ex.a: The double quote before Asian ends the PHP string early → parse error. Use single quotes inside: 'Asian'.
ex.az: 内部双引号提早结束字符串，语法错误。内部改单引号。

ex.q: Why two steps instead of putting SQL straight into mysqli_query()?
ex.a: Both work, but a variable makes the code easier to read, to echo $query for debugging, and to build up in parts.
ex.az: 两者皆可；用变量更易读、可 echo 除错、可分段组合。

code.src:
$query = "SELECT name, floor FROM restaurants WHERE category = 'Asian'";
$result = mysqli_query($link, $query);

notes.t: Step 1: build the SQL as a string.
notes.tz: 第 1 步：把 SQL 写成字符串。

notes.t: Step 2: run it; $result is a mysqli_result object.
notes.tz: 第 2 步：执行；$result 是 mysqli_result object。

demo.setup: CREATE TABLE restaurants(code INTEGER, name TEXT, category TEXT, floor INTEGER); INSERT INTO restaurants VALUES (1001,'Noodle House','Asian',1),(1002,'Pasta Bar','Western',2),(2003,'Sushi Go','Asian',2),(2004,'Burger Hub','Western',3),(3005,'Dim Sum Hall','Asian',3);
demo.note: This is the SQL inside $query. Text values use single quotes.

cards.en:
Syntax: $result = mysqli_query($link, $query);

  • 1st: the mysqli object from mysqli_connect() (the ticket)
  • 2nd: the SQL string

⚠ Order is ($link, $query). ($query, $link) is wrong.

OutcomeReturns
Failure (e.g. SQL error)false
Success, SELECTa mysqli_result object (like a table; fetch rows from it)
Success, INSERT/UPDATE/DELETEtrue

Exam wording: mysqli_query() takes a mysqli object and an SQL string; for SELECT it returns a mysqli_result object, for other successful queries it returns true, and false on failure.
cards.zh:
语法：$result = mysqli_query($link, $query);

  • 第 1：mysqli object
  • 第 2：SQL 字符串

⚠ 次序是 ($link, $query)。

结果返回
失败false
SELECT 成功mysqli_result object
INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE 成功true

考试写法：同英文。

ex.q: What does mysqli_query() return for (a) a valid SELECT (b) a valid DELETE (c) SELECT from a missing table?
ex.a: (a) a mysqli_result object (b) true (c) false.

ex.q: Wrong: $result = mysqli_query($query, $link);
ex.a: Parameters are swapped. The connection object must come first: mysqli_query($link, $query).
ex.az: 参数次序调转，连接 object 要放第一。

ex.q: Can you echo $result directly to show the restaurants?
ex.a: No. It is an object, not text. You must fetch each row with mysqli_fetch_assoc() and echo its values.
ex.az: 不能；它是 object，要用 fetch_assoc 逐行取出。

notes.t: Run a DELETE; success returns true.
notes.tz: 执行 DELETE；成功返回 true。

cards.t: Column name case and LIKE wildcards
cards.tz: Column 名大小写与 LIKE 通配符
cards.en:
Column names become array keys. The key in $row is exactly what the result column is called:

  • SELECT Name ... → key "Name"; $row["name"] may not find it (PHP keys are case-sensitive).
  • With an alias, the alias is the key: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n → $row["n"].
  • Tip: use lowercase everywhere.

LIKE wildcards in MySQL: % = any number of characters, _ = exactly one. * and ? are MS Access style and do not work in MySQL.

Exam wording: The index of $row must match the column name (or alias) in the query result. Use LIKE 'H%' for names starting with H.
cards.zh:
栏位名会变成 array key，要完全一致：

  • SELECT Name → key 是 "Name"，用 $row["name"] 可能找不到（区分大小写）。
  • 有 alias 则用 alias。
  • 建议全部小写。

MySQL LIKE：% 任意个字符，_ 一个字符。*、? 是 Access 写法，MySQL 不适用。

考试写法：The index of $row must match the column name (or alias)；用 LIKE 'H%'。

ex.q: Find restaurants whose name starts with 'S'.
ex.a:
SELECT name FROM restaurants WHERE name LIKE 'S%';
Result: Sushi Go.

ex.q: Wrong: WHERE name LIKE 'S*' in MySQL.
ex.a: * is not a wildcard in MySQL, so it looks for names that are literally 'S*' → 0 rows. Use 'S%'.
ex.az: MySQL 不认 *，结果 0 行。改 'S%'。

ex.q: SELECT AVG(floor) FROM restaurants. What key holds the answer? Fix it.
ex.a: The key would be the text "AVG(floor)", awkward to type. Use an alias: SELECT AVG(floor) AS avg_floor → $row["avg_floor"] = 2.2.
ex.az: key 是 "AVG(floor)"，难用；加 alias avg_floor，值 2.2。

demo.setup: CREATE TABLE restaurants(code INTEGER, name TEXT, category TEXT, floor INTEGER); INSERT INTO restaurants VALUES (1001,'Noodle House','Asian',1),(1002,'Pasta Bar','Western',2),(2003,'Sushi Go','Asian',2),(2004,'Burger Hub','Western',3),(3005,'Dim Sum Hall','Asian',3);
demo.query: SELECT name FROM restaurants WHERE name LIKE 'S%';
demo.note: % matches any characters after S. Try changing it to '%a%'.

cards.en:
Intuition: the result is a stack of cards. Each call takes the top card and shows it; when the stack is empty you get nothing (NULL).

mysqli_fetch_assoc($result) returns one row as an associative array: column names → keys, values → values. No rows left → NULL.

  • Use while ($row = mysqli_fetch_assoc($result)) to visit every row.
  • Each loop: keys stay the same, values change.

Use the step demo to watch $row change.

Exam wording: mysqli_fetch_assoc() fetches one row from the query result and returns it as an associative array with column names as indexes; it returns NULL when there are no more rows, which ends the while loop.
cards.zh:
直觉：结果像一叠卡，每次拿最上面一张；拿完就得到 NULL。

mysqli_fetch_assoc($result) 返回一行，格式为 associative array：栏位名 → key。没有行时返回 NULL。

  • 用 while ($row = mysqli_fetch_assoc($result)) 走遍所有行。
  • 每次循环 key 不变，值改变。

考试写法：同英文。

ex.q: Using the restaurants table, what does the code output?
ex.a:
The query keeps 3 Asian rows, so the loop runs 3 times:
<ul><li>Noodle House on floor 1</li><li>Sushi Go on floor 2</li><li>Dim Sum Hall on floor 3</li></ul>
ex.az: 3 行 Asian，循环 3 次，输出 3 个 <li>。

ex.q: Wrong: $row = mysqli_fetch_assoc($result); echo $row['name']; to show all names.
ex.a: This fetches only the first row. Put the fetch in a while loop to get every row.
ex.az: 只取第一行，要放进 while 循环。

ex.q: What is $row after the 2nd call?
ex.a: ['name' => 'Sushi Go', 'floor' => 2].

notes.t: Step 1: build the SQL as a string.
notes.tz: 第 1 步：把 SQL 写成字符串。

notes.t: Step 2: run it; $result is a mysqli_result object.
notes.tz: 第 2 步：执行；$result 是 mysqli_result object。

notes.t: Take the next row as an array; stop when NULL.
Put this row's values into one <li>.

code.out:
• Noodle House on floor 1
  • Sushi Go on floor 2
  • Dim Sum Hall on floor 3

demo.title: How mysqli_fetch_assoc() walks through a result

frames.en: $result holds 3 rows: Noodle House/1, Sushi Go/2, Dim Sum Hall/3.
$row = ['name'=>'Noodle House','floor'=>1]. Not NULL → loop body runs.
frames.zh: $row = 第 1 行，不是 NULL → 执行循环。

frames.en: $row = ['name'=>'Sushi Go','floor'=>2]. Same keys, new values.
frames.zh: $row = 第 2 行，key 一样，值不同。

frames.en: $row = ['name'=>'Dim Sum Hall','floor'=>3].
No rows left → returns NULL → condition false → loop ends.
frames.zh: 没有行 → 返回 NULL → 循环结束。

cards.t: Enrichment: why '=' works in the while condition
cards.tz: Enrichment：为何 while 条件用 = 可行
cards.en:
In while ($row = mysqli_fetch_assoc($result)) the single = is on purpose.

  1. Each call returns the next row and moves an internal row pointer forward (the book says the top row is 'removed').
  2. PHP first assigns the value to $row, then tests that value as a Boolean.
  3. A non-empty array → true → loop runs. NULL (and false, 0, '') → false → loop stops.

So the loop runs exactly once per row.

Exam wording: The assignment stores the fetched row in $row and the assigned value is used as the loop condition; when NULL is returned the condition is false and the loop ends.
cards.zh:
while ($row = mysqli_fetch_assoc($result)) 中的单个 = 是刻意的。

  1. 每次调用返回下一行，内部 row pointer 前移。
  2. PHP 先赋值给 $row，再把该值当 Boolean 测试。
  3. 非空 array → true；NULL → false → 停止。

考试写法：同英文。

ex.q: How many times is the loop body run for a result with 0 rows?
ex.a: 0 times. The first call returns NULL, so the condition is false immediately.

ex.q: Wrong 'fix': while ($row == mysqli_fetch_assoc($result))
ex.a: == compares an undefined $row with the row. It is false at once (or loops wrongly) and $row is never set. Here = (assignment) is correct.
ex.az: == 只是比较，$row 从未被赋值。此处应用 =。

ex.q: Which values count as false in PHP's while test?
ex.a: NULL, false, 0, 0.0, '' (empty string), '0' and an empty array.

cards.t: Embedding array values in strings; full listing page
cards.tz: 在字符串插入数组值；完整列表页
cards.en:
Inside a double-quoted string, wrap an array element in curly braces: "<td>{$row['code']}</td>". Without braces, quoted keys cause a parse error.

A double-quoted string can span lines, so one echo can print a whole <tr>.

Page structure (list_restaurants.php):

  1. Connect (with die()).
  2. HTML heading, <table>, header row of <th>.
  3. Query + while loop: echo one <tr> per record.
  4. Close </table>.

Exam wording: For each record in the query result, the script outputs a table row containing the field values.
cards.zh:
在双引号字符串中用大括号包住 array 元素：{$row['code']}。不加括号，带引号的 key 会出错。

双引号字符串可跨行，一个 echo 输出整个 <tr>。

页面结构：连接 → 标题与表头 → 查询 + while，每条记录一个 <tr> → 结束表格。

考试写法：For each record in the query result, the script outputs a table row containing the field values.

ex.q: Write the echo for one row with code and name.
ex.a: echo "<tr><td>{$row['code']}</td><td>{$row['name']}</td></tr>";

ex.q: Wrong: echo "<td>$row['name']</td>";
ex.a: Quoted key without braces inside a double-quoted string → parse error. Use {$row['name']} or concatenation "<td>" . $row['name'] . "</td>".
ex.az: 没有大括号会语法错误，加 {} 或用 . 连接。

ex.q: 5 restaurants are in the table. How many <tr> appear in the HTML?
ex.a: 6: one header row plus 5 data rows.
ex.az: 6 个：1 个表头 + 5 行资料。

code.src:
"; } ?>
CodeName
{$row['code']}{$row['name']}

cards.en:
Intuition: a search can succeed but find nothing, like a correct library search with 0 books.

mysqli_num_rows($result) returns the number of rows in a result object. Use it to show 'not found'.

⚠ An empty result is still an object, so if (!$result) does not catch it.

Aggregates (COUNT, SUM, AVG, MAX, MIN) return one row. Give them an alias and fetch once:

$r = mysqli_query($link, "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM restaurants");
$row = mysqli_fetch_assoc($r);
echo $row['n'];   // 5

Exam wording: mysqli_num_rows() returns the number of rows in the query result; if it is 0, no record satisfies the condition.
cards.zh:
直觉：查询成功也可能找不到东西，好像搜寻正确但 0 本书。

mysqli_num_rows($result) 返回结果行数，用来显示“找不到”。

⚠ 空结果仍是 object，if (!$result) 检测不到。

聚合函数只返回一行，加 alias 后 fetch 一次即可。

考试写法：同英文。

ex.q: Code 2010 does not exist. What prints?
ex.a: mysqli_num_rows returns 0, so the if branch runs: This restaurant does not exist!
ex.az: 返回 0，输出 This restaurant does not exist!

ex.q: Wrong: if (!$result) { echo "Not found"; } to detect no matching rows.
ex.a: An empty SELECT still returns a result object (truthy). Use mysqli_num_rows($result) == 0.
ex.az: 空结果仍是 object，应用 num_rows == 0。

ex.q: Show the number of Asian restaurants.
ex.a:
$r = mysqli_query($link, "SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM restaurants WHERE category='Asian'");
$row = mysqli_fetch_assoc($r);
echo "Asian: {$row['n']}";
Output: Asian: 3

demo.setup: CREATE TABLE restaurants(code INTEGER, name TEXT, category TEXT, floor INTEGER); INSERT INTO restaurants VALUES (1001,'Noodle House','Asian',1),(1002,'Pasta Bar','Western',2),(2003,'Sushi Go','Asian',2),(2004,'Burger Hub','Western',3),(3005,'Dim Sum Hall','Asian',3);
demo.query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM restaurants WHERE category = 'Asian';
demo.note: One row, one column called n. In PHP: $row['n'].

cards.t: Example 4.2: calculations, counters and conditions in the loop
cards.tz: Example 4.2：loop 中计算、计数与条件
cards.en:
Inside the fetch loop you can use any PHP: arithmetic, a counter for rank, and if statements.

Example 4.2 (topThree.php): list students with more than 75 in all three subjects, highest total first, with rank and total.

  • SQL does the filter and sort.
  • PHP calculates $total and keeps a counter $i.

Exam wording: Initialise a counter before the loop and increment it inside the loop to show the rank of each record.
cards.zh:
fetch 循环里可写任何 PHP：计算、计数器、if。

Example 4.2：列出三科都高于 75 的学生，按总分由高至低，显示名次与总分。

  • SQL 负责筛选和排序。
  • PHP 计算 $total，用 $i 计名次。

考试写法：Initialise a counter before the loop and increment it inside the loop...

ex.q: Trace the output with the sample data.
ex.a:
1. Ben (english 70) is filtered out.
2. Totals: Kitty 259, Amy 253, Tom 255 → ordered Kitty, Tom, Amy.
3. Output rows: 1 Kitty Lam 259; 2 Tom Ho 255; 3 Amy Lee 253.

ex.q: Wrong: $i = 1; written inside the while loop.
ex.a: The counter resets every iteration, so every student shows rank 1. Initialise before the loop.
ex.az: 每次都重设为 1，全部显示第 1 名。要放在循环前。

ex.q: Add a mark 'Excellent' when total ≥ 255.
ex.a: Inside the loop: if ($total >= 255) { echo " Excellent"; }. Kitty and Tom get it.
ex.az: 循环内加 if；Kitty、Tom 符合。

notes.t: Rank counter starts at 1, before the loop.
notes.tz: 名次计数器在循环前设为 1。

code.out:
1 Kitty Lam 259
2 Tom Ho 255
3 Amy Lee 253

demo.setup: CREATE TABLE student_marks(name TEXT, english INTEGER, math INTEGER, ict INTEGER); INSERT INTO student_marks VALUES ('Tom Ho',80,90,85),('Amy Lee',76,78,99),('Ben Chan',70,95,90),('Kitty Lam',88,92,79);

cards.en:
Intuition: a search box only asks, it changes nothing, so the question can live in the URL like a bookmarkable address.

<form method="GET" action="">
  <input type="text" name="city">
  <input type="submit" name="submit" value="Search">
</form>
  • GET: only retrieves data, no change to server state; URL can be bookmarked or shared.
  • action="": send data to the same page, so results appear under the form.
  • After submit: city_search.php?city=Hong+Kong&submit=Search (space → +).
  • Use isset($_GET['submit']) to know if the form was submitted.

Exam wording: GET is used because the request only retrieves data without changing the server state, and the result page can be bookmarked.
cards.zh:
直觉：搜寻只是“问”，不改变任何东西，所以问题可放在 URL 里，可加书签。

  • GET：只读取资料，不改变服务器状态，URL 可收藏、分享。
  • action=""：送回同一页，结果显示在表单下。
  • 提交后：?city=Hong+Kong&submit=Search。
  • 用 isset($_GET['submit']) 判断是否已提交。

考试写法：同英文。

ex.q: User types 'New York' and clicks Search. What is the URL?
ex.a: city_search.php?city=New+York&submit=Search. Space becomes +, fields joined by &.

ex.q: Wrong: using POST for the city search 'for security'.
ex.a: Search does not change data, and users may want to bookmark/share results. GET is correct. (Security comes from sanitising, not from POST.)
ex.az: 搜寻不改资料，要可收藏，应 GET。保安靠 sanitise，不是 POST。

ex.q: Why check isset($_GET['submit']) before querying?
ex.a: On the first visit nothing is submitted, so $_GET['city'] does not exist. The check makes the search run only after the form is sent.
ex.az: 第一次打开时未提交，检查后才查询。

cards.t: Parsing variables into SQL; dynamic WHERE
cards.tz: 把变量放入 SQL；动态 WHERE
cards.en:
Intuition: the SQL is just a sentence; you can fill in the blank at runtime.

$c = "US";
$query = "SELECT name FROM city_info WHERE country = '{$c}'";
  • Text column: single quotes around the variable: '{$c}'.
  • Number column: no quotes: population > {$min}.

Optional filters: start with WHERE TRUE, then add AND ... for each field the user filled in.

$sql = "SELECT * FROM headphones WHERE TRUE";
if (!empty($brand)) { $sql .= " AND brand = '{$brand}'"; }
if (!empty($max))   { $sql .= " AND price <= {$max}"; }

Exam wording: Variables are parsed into the SQL string so the query condition can be changed at runtime.
cards.zh:
直觉：SQL 只是一句话，可在执行时填空。

  • 文字栏：变量外加单引号 '{$c}'。
  • 数字栏：不用引号。

可选条件：由 WHERE TRUE 开始，用户填了哪项就加 AND ...。

考试写法：Variables are parsed into the SQL string so the query condition can be changed at runtime.

ex.q: $c = 'China'. What SQL string is produced and what rows come back?
ex.a: SELECT name FROM city_info WHERE country = 'China' → Hong Kong, Shanghai.

ex.q: Wrong: "... WHERE country = {$c}" with $c = 'US'.
ex.a: Becomes WHERE country = US; MySQL treats US as a column name → error. Add quotes: '{$c}'.
ex.az: 变成 country = US，被当作栏位名而出错。要加单引号。

ex.q: $brand empty, $max = 300. Build the final SQL.
ex.a: Start: SELECT * FROM headphones WHERE TRUE; brand skipped; add AND price <= 300. Final: SELECT * FROM headphones WHERE TRUE AND price <= 300.
ex.az: brand 略过，只加 price 条件。

notes.t: Base query; TRUE matches every row.
notes.tz: 基本查询，TRUE 配合所有行。

notes.t: Add brand filter only if filled in (text → quotes).
notes.tz: 有填品牌才加（文字要引号）。

notes.t: Add price filter only if filled in (number → no quotes).
notes.tz: 有填价钱才加（数字不用引号）。

notes.t: Show the final SQL (useful for debugging).

code.out: SELECT * FROM headphones WHERE TRUE AND price <= 300

demo.setup: CREATE TABLE city_info(name TEXT, country TEXT, population INTEGER); INSERT INTO city_info VALUES ('Hong Kong','China',7500000),('Shanghai','China',24900000),('New York','US',8300000),('Chicago','US',2700000),('Tokyo','Japan',14000000);
demo.query: SELECT name FROM city_info WHERE country = 'China';
demo.note: This is the SQL after PHP puts $c = 'China' into the string.

cards.t: implode() and IN with multiple values
cards.tz: implode() 与 IN 多值条件
cards.en:
implode(separator, array) joins all array elements into one string with the separator between them.

implode(",", ["Oil","Salt","Sugar"])   // Oil,Salt,Sugar

Checkboxes → IN: to filter by several text values, join with "','" (quote-comma-quote) and add (' and ') outside:

$c = ["China","US"];
$values = implode("','", $c);        // China','US
$q = "SELECT * FROM city_info WHERE country IN ('{$values}')";

Exam wording: implode() combines the elements of an array into a single string separated by the given separator.
cards.zh:
implode(分隔符, array) 把所有元素合成一个字符串。

Checkbox → IN：用 "','" 连接，外面加 (' 和 ')，得到 IN ('China','US')。

考试写法：implode() combines the elements of an array into a single string separated by the given separator.

ex.q: What is implode(" | ", ["A","B","C"])?
ex.a: A | B | C

ex.q: Wrong: "... IN (" . implode(",", $c) . ")" with text values.
ex.a: Gives IN (China,US): no quotes, so China and US are read as column names → error. Use "IN ('" . implode("','", $c) . "')".

ex.q: Checked: Japan, US. Which cities are returned?
ex.a: SQL: WHERE country IN ('Japan','US') → New York, Chicago, Tokyo.

code.out: SELECT name FROM city_info WHERE country IN ('China','US')

demo.setup: CREATE TABLE city_info(name TEXT, country TEXT, population INTEGER); INSERT INTO city_info VALUES ('Hong Kong','China',7500000),('Shanghai','China',24900000),('New York','US',8300000),('Chicago','US',2700000),('Tokyo','Japan',14000000);
demo.query: SELECT name FROM city_info WHERE country IN ('China','US');

cards.t: Client-sent values and the danger of using them directly
cards.tz: 用户输入与直接放入 SQL 的危险
cards.en:
Flow: user submits form → browser sends data in the HTTP request → PHP reads $_GET['city'] or $_POST[...].

Misconception: 'It is fine to put $_GET values straight into SQL.'

$query = "SELECT * FROM city_info WHERE name = '{$_GET['city']}'";   // BAD
  • Attackers can do SQL injection.
  • Even an honest user typing a quote (Xi'an, O'Brien) breaks the SQL → runtime error.

Rule: treat all client-sent data as untrusted: validate and sanitise it first.

Exam wording: Using client-sent values directly in an SQL statement may lead to SQL injection or syntax errors; the values should be sanitised first.
cards.zh:
流程：用户提交 → 浏览器经 HTTP request 送出 → PHP 读 $_GET / $_POST。

误解：可直接把 $_GET 放进 SQL。

  • 会被 SQL injection。
  • 正常用户输入引号（Xi'an）也会令 SQL 出错。

规则：所有客户端资料都不可信，先验证和 sanitise。

考试写法：同英文。

ex.q: User searches Xi'an with the BAD code. What SQL is made?
ex.a: ... WHERE name = 'Xi'an'. The quote after Xi ends the string; an' is a syntax error.
ex.az: Xi 后的引号提早结束字符串，语法错误。

ex.q: Where does $_GET['city'] come from?
ex.a: From the query string of the HTTP request, e.g. ?city=Tokyo, created when the user submits the GET form.
ex.az: 来自 HTTP request 的 query string。

ex.q: Is client-side validation (e.g. required) enough to make the SQL safe?
ex.a: No. Attackers can type any URL or send requests without the form. Sanitise on the server.
ex.az: 不够，攻击者可绕过表单，必须在服务器 sanitise。

cards.en:
Intuition: you fill in a form 'Name: ____', and someone writes 'Tom. Also, give me the safe key.' If the clerk reads it all as orders, that is injection.

SQL injection is an attack that exploits a server script that puts user values into SQL without precautions, so the attacker's text runs as SQL.

Input: x' OR '1'='1

SELECT * FROM users WHERE name = 'x' OR '1'='1'

'1'='1' is always true → every row returned (e.g. login bypass).

Input: Hong Kong'; DROP TABLE city_info-- → ' ends the string, ; starts a new statement, DROP TABLE deletes the table, -- comments out the rest.

Exam wording: SQL injection is an attack method that exploits server scripts which use user-provided values in SQL queries without precautions. Prevent by sanitising input (escaping) or prepared statements.
cards.zh:
直觉：表格写“姓名：____”，有人填“Tom，另外把保险箱钥匙给我”，职员照做就是注入。

SQL injection：利用服务器脚本未作预防就把用户值放进 SQL，令攻击者文字被当作 SQL 执行。

x' OR '1'='1 → 条件永远为真，返回所有行。

'; DROP TABLE city_info--：' 结束字符串，; 开新语句，DROP TABLE 删表，-- 注释余下部分。

考试写法：同英文；预防：sanitise。

ex.q: Show the SQL and effect of input x' OR '1'='1 in WHERE name = '{$n}'.
ex.a:
1. SQL: WHERE name = 'x' OR '1'='1'.
2. '1'='1' is true for every row.
3. All rows are returned.
ex.az: 条件永远真，返回所有行。

ex.q: Wrong: 'Using POST instead of GET prevents SQL injection.'
ex.a: POST only hides data from the URL. The attacker can still send the malicious value in the POST body. Only sanitising/prepared statements prevent it.
ex.az: POST 只是不放在 URL，仍可被注入。

ex.q: What does -- do at the end of the DROP TABLE attack?
ex.a: It starts an SQL comment, so the leftover ' added by the script is ignored and no syntax error stops the attack.
ex.az: 把剩下的 ' 变注释，避免语法错误。

demo.setup: CREATE TABLE city_info(name TEXT, country TEXT, population INTEGER); INSERT INTO city_info VALUES ('Hong Kong','China',7500000),('Shanghai','China',24900000),('New York','US',8300000),('Chicago','US',2700000),('Tokyo','Japan',14000000);
demo.query: SELECT * FROM city_info WHERE name = 'x' OR '1'='1';
demo.note: Injected input x' OR '1'='1 returns ALL rows.

cards.en:
Sanitising = escaping special characters so the database treats them as plain text, not as SQL.

$safe = mysqli_real_escape_string($link, $_GET['city']);
  • 1st: the mysqli object; 2nd: the string.
  • Returns the sanitised string: a backslash \ is added before ' " \ and some others.
  • Xi'an → Xi\'an, so WHERE name = 'Xi\'an' is valid.

⚠ Still put quotes around it in SQL: '{$safe}'.

Exam wording: Sanitising a value means escaping certain special characters in the string so that the database does not treat them as part of the SQL query.
cards.zh:
Sanitise = 转义特殊字符，令数据库把它们当普通文字。

  • 第 1：mysqli object；第 2：字符串。
  • 返回处理后字符串：在 ' " \ 等前加反斜线。
  • Xi'an → Xi\'an。

⚠ SQL 中仍要加引号 '{$safe}'。

考试写法：同英文。

ex.q: Sanitise x' OR '1'='1. What SQL results?
ex.a: Escaped: x\' OR \'1\'=\'1. SQL: WHERE name = 'x\' OR \'1\'=\'1': one text value, so it looks for a city literally named that → 0 rows. Attack fails.
ex.az: 整段变成一个字符串值，0 行，攻击失败。

ex.q: Wrong: $safe = mysqli_real_escape_string($_GET['city']);
ex.a: The connection object is missing. It must be mysqli_real_escape_string($link, $_GET['city']), so call it after connecting.
ex.az: 漏了 $link，且必须在连接后调用。

ex.q: Why does the function need $link?
ex.a: It uses the connection's character set to escape correctly, so it must be called after mysqli_connect().
ex.az: 要按连接的字符集正确转义。

notes.t: Escape special characters in the input.
notes.tz: 转义输入中的特殊字符。

notes.t: Use the safe value, still inside quotes.

cards.t: Full example: city_search.php and Chapter Summary
cards.tz: 完整例子 city_search.php 与本章总结
cards.en:
All the pieces together:

  1. Connect (mysqli_connect + die).
  2. Form with GET, action="".
  3. If isset($_GET['submit']): sanitise → build SQL → mysqli_query.
  4. num_rows = 0 → 'Not found'; else while + fetch_assoc → echo HTML.
FunctionInputOutput
mysqli_connecthost, user, pw, dbobject / false
mysqli_query$link, SQLresult / true / false
mysqli_fetch_assocresultarray / NULL
mysqli_num_rowsresultinteger
mysqli_real_escape_string$link, stringescaped string

Exam wording: connect → sanitise → query → fetch → generate HTML.
cards.zh:
整合：

  1. 连接（+ die）。
  2. GET 表单，action=""。
  3. 已提交：sanitise → 组 SQL → query。
  4. num_rows 为 0 → 找不到；否则 while + fetch_assoc 输出 HTML。

函数表见英文。

考试写法：connect → sanitise → query → fetch → generate HTML。

ex.q: User searches 'Tokyo'. Trace the output.
ex.a:
1. submit is set.
2. safe = 'Tokyo'.
3. SQL finds 1 row.
4. Output: Country: Japan, Population: 14000000.

ex.q: Wrong order: calling mysqli_real_escape_string() before mysqli_connect().
ex.a: Escaping needs the connection object, so $link must exist first. Connect at the top of the page.

ex.q: User searches 'Paris' (not in the table). What shows?
ex.a: num_rows is 0 → No city found.
ex.az: num_rows 为 0，显示 No city found.

code.src:
<?php require 'config.php';
$link = mysqli_connect($db_server, $db_username, $db_password, $db_database);
if (!$link) { die("ERROR: Webserver could not connect to database!"); } ?>
<form method="GET" action="">
  <input type="text" name="city"> <input type="submit" name="submit">
</form>
<?php if (isset($_GET['submit'])) {
  $safe_city = mysqli_real_escape_string($link, $_GET['city']);
  $result = mysqli_query($link, "SELECT * FROM city_info WHERE name = '{$safe_city}'");
  if (mysqli_num_rows($result) == 0) { echo "No city found."; }
  while ($row = mysqli_fetch_assoc($result)) {
    echo "Country: {$row['country']}, Population: {$row['population']}";
  }
} ?>

notes.t: Only after the form is submitted.

frames.en: Browser sends GET city_search.php?city=Tokyo&submit=Submit.
frames.zh: 浏览器发送 GET 请求。

frames.en: PHP escapes 'Tokyo' and sends SELECT ... WHERE name = 'Tokyo'.
Database returns 1 row (Tokyo, Japan, 14000000).
PHP echoes 'Country: Japan, Population: 14000000' in the page.
frames.zh: PHP 输出 HTML 回浏览器。

cards.en:
Intuition: adding a record changes the server, like posting a letter, so use POST.

  • Read values from $_POST, sanitise each.
  • Build INSERT INTO table (cols) VALUES (...).
  • mysqli_query() returns true on success, false on failure: check it.

Exam wording: POST is used because the request changes the state of the server (a new record is inserted).
cards.zh:
直觉：新增记录会改变服务器，像寄信，所以用 POST。

  • 从 $_POST 读值，逐个 sanitise。
  • 组 INSERT INTO ... VALUES (...)。
  • 成功返回 true，失败 false，要检查。

考试写法：POST is used because the request changes the state of the server.

ex.q: User 12 rates game 1 with 3. What SQL runs and what is the new average for game 1?
ex.a: INSERT INTO ratings (game_id, user_id, rating) VALUES (1, 12, 3). Ratings 4, 5, 3 → average 4.

ex.q: Wrong: using a GET form for rating.php.
ex.a: GET puts data in the URL; refreshing or sharing the link would insert the rating again, and the request changes server state. Use POST.
ex.az: GET 会因刷新/分享重复插入；改变状态应用 POST。

ex.q: How do you know the INSERT worked?
ex.a: Check the return value: if (mysqli_query($conn, $q)) echo "Saved"; else echo "Error";

demo.setup: CREATE TABLE ratings(game_id INTEGER, user_id INTEGER, rating INTEGER); INSERT INTO ratings VALUES (1,10,4),(1,11,5); INSERT INTO ratings VALUES (1,12,3);
demo.query: SELECT game_id, AVG(rating) AS avg_rating, COUNT(*) AS n FROM ratings GROUP BY game_id;
demo.note: After the INSERT, game 1 has 3 ratings, average 4.

ex.q: Fill the blanks: connect → ____ → query → ____ → HTML.
ex.a: sanitise; fetch (mysqli_fetch_assoc in a while loop).

ex.q: Wrong: mysqli_query($sql, $link).
ex.a: Order is ($link, $sql).

ex.q: Which function tells you a search found nothing?
ex.a: mysqli_num_rows($result) == 0.

mc.q: In the textbook model, how does a web server communicate with a database?
o: Through an API such as mysqli
Through cookies stored in the browser
mc.e: Web server and database are separate entities that communicate through an API; HTTP is used between client and web server.
mc.ez: Web server 与数据库用 API 通讯；HTTP 是 client 与 server 之间。

mc.q: How does the client (browser) communicate with the web server?
mc.e: Client ↔ server uses HTTP.
mc.ez: Client 与 server 用 HTTP。

mc.q: Which side executes the SQL query?
o: The PHP interpreter on the client
mc.e: The database executes SQL and returns the query result to the web server.
mc.ez: 数据库执行 SQL，把结果返回 web server。

mc.q: What does the browser finally receive when it requests list_students.php?
o: An HTML file generated by the script
mc.e: The script uses the query result to generate HTML, which is sent back.
mc.ez: 浏览器只收到生成的 HTML。

mc.q: Which of the following is an example of using an API?
o: A news site shows weather data provided by the Observatory's service
A PHP script declares a variable
mc.e: An API lets a program use services provided by another program.
mc.ez: API 让程序使用另一程序的服务，如天文台天气。

mc.q: Which DBMS can the mysqli API connect to?
mc.e: mysqli only connects to databases using MySQL as the DBMS.

mc.q: Which function fetches the next row of a query result as an associative array?
mc.e: mysqli_fetch_assoc() returns the next row with column names as indexes.
mc.ez: mysqli_fetch_assoc() 取下一行成 associative array。

mc.q: Why do API functions such as mysqli_connect() need error-catching more than built-in functions like isset()?
o: They involve behind-the-scenes operations and network communications, so they are more likely to fail
They cannot be used inside if statements
mc.e: Network/other-server dependence means a higher risk of failure (e.g. database offline).
mc.ez: 涉及网络通讯，较易失败。

mc.q: What is the correct order of the four parameters of mysqli_connect()?
mc.e: Hostname → username → password → database name.

mc.q: What does mysqli_connect() return if the connection fails?
mc.e: Failure returns Boolean False; success returns a mysqli object.

mc.q: What does mysqli_connect() return on success?
o: A mysqli object representing the connection
mc.e: Success returns a mysqli object (the 'ticket').

mc.q: Why is it poor practice for a live web server to connect using the 'root' account?
o: root has the highest administrative rights, so leaked credentials could let attackers drop tables or databases
root can only be used with localhost
mc.e: root should only be used in local development/debugging.
mc.ez: root 权限最高，只应在本地开发用。

mc.q: What does the hostname 'localhost' indicate in mysqli_connect()?
o: The database is on the user's browser
The database and the web server are hosted on the same machine
mc.e: localhost / 127.0.0.1 = same machine, common in development (e.g. XAMPP).
mc.ez: localhost = 同一部机，常见于 XAMPP 开发。

o: the length of a password hash
mc.e: 3306 is MySQL's default TCP port; the optional 5th parameter.

mc.q: Consider: $link = mysqli_connect(...); if (!$link) { die("Error"); } echo "OK"; The database server is offline. What is output?
mc.e: die() outputs the string and terminates; echo is never reached.

mc.q: Which is NOT a likely reason for mysqli_connect() to fail?
o: The query result has no rows
mc.e: An empty result relates to a query, not to connecting.
mc.ez: 结果没有行与连接无关。

mc.q: A web server only displays a product catalogue. Which permission should its database account be given?
mc.e: Authorisation control: least privilege limits damage if credentials leak.
mc.ez: 只给 SELECT，泄漏时损失有限。

mc.q: Which statement about database accounts is correct?
o: Every end user logs in to the database with mysqli_connect()
Each web server usually has its own database account; users' login details are used as values in queries
Only one database can be hosted on one database server
Database accounts do not need passwords
mc.e: Users rarely connect to databases directly (Example 4.1).
mc.ez: 用户很少直接连接数据库。

mc.q: Which is a benefit of NOT writing database credentials directly in each PHP file?
o: Developers working on scripts are isolated from the credentials
mc.e: Also: easier to manage credentials across many files/environments.
mc.ez: 开发者接触不到密码；易于管理。

mc.q: What is an object, compared with a primitive data type?
o: A value that can only be an integer
A data item with its own properties and behaviours
A Boolean that can be NULL
mc.e: Objects have properties and behaviours; primitives are string, integer, Boolean, float.
mc.ez: Object 有 property 和 behaviour。

mc.q: Which statement correctly executes $q on the connection $link?
mc.e: 1st parameter: mysqli object; 2nd: SQL string.

mc.q: A successful UPDATE query is executed with mysqli_query(). What is returned?
mc.e: INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE return True on success.

mc.q: A successful SELECT query is executed with mysqli_query(). What is returned?
mc.e: SELECT returns a mysqli_result object representing the query result.

mc.q: Which PHP statement forms a valid SQL string?
mc.e: Use single quotes for SQL text inside a double-quoted PHP string.
mc.ez: 双引号 PHP 字符串内用单引号。

mc.q: Why does the book recommend writing column names in lowercase in SQL?

pr.t: Add a review with POST + INSERT
pr.tz: 用 POST + INSERT 新增评分
pr.task: rating.php receives game_id, user_id, rating by POST. Sanitise them, INSERT into review, and echo "Review added successfully." or "There is an error.". Also reject ratings not between 1 and 5.

check.model:
<?php
$game_id = mysqli_real_escape_string($conn, $_POST['game_id']);
$user_id = mysqli_real_escape_string($conn, $_POST['user_id']);
$rating  = mysqli_real_escape_string($conn, $_POST['rating']);
if (!is_numeric($rating) || $rating < 1 || $rating > 5) {
  die("Rating must be 1-5");
}
$query = "INSERT INTO review VALUES('$game_id','$user_id','$rating')";
if (mysqli_query($conn, $query)) {
  echo "Review added successfully.";
} else {
  echo "There is an error.";
}
?>

Key points: POST because it changes server state; INSERT returns True/False; server-side validation before the query.

pr.solution:
<?php
$game_id = mysqli_real_escape_string($conn, $_POST['game_id']);
$user_id = mysqli_real_escape_string($conn, $_POST['user_id']);
$rating  = mysqli_real_escape_string($conn, $_POST['rating']);
if (!is_numeric($rating) || $rating < 1 || $rating > 5) {
  die("Rating must be 1-5");
}
$query = "INSERT INTO review VALUES('$game_id','$user_id','$rating')";
if (mysqli_query($conn, $query)) {
  echo "Review added successfully.";
} else {
  echo "There is an error.";
}
?>

pr.t: Count with an alias in PHP
pr.task: Print "There are N restaurants on floor F." where F comes from $_GET["floor"] (validate it is numeric).
pr.taskz: 输出某楼层的餐厅数目，floor 来自 $_GET 并须验证为数字。

check.model:
<?php
